Title: CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE & CRM INSIGHTS SR SPECIALIST
Description:
Il nostro cliente è una primaria multinazionale italiana leader globale nel settore Retail & Healthcare, con una presenza capillare in oltre 25 Paesi e un network di migliaia di punti vendita a livello internazionale.

Per il potenziamento del proprio Global Center of Expertise (CoE) presso l'Headquarter di Milano, siamo alla ricerca di un Customer Intelligence & CRM Insights Sr Specialist / Manager.




Descrizione del Ruolo

La risorsa inserita sarà il punto di riferimento analitico e strategico per l'evoluzione del CRM 2.0 su scala globale, orientato all'iper-personalizzazione.

Rispondendo all'Associate Director Global CRM e lavorando all'interno di un team strutturato e dinamico, la figura opererà come Business Partner di livello globale, coordinando risorse esterne/consulenti e affiancando direttamente i Country Manager e Marketing Director delle varie filiali estere nella traduzione dei dati in leve di business.




Responsabilità Chiave

CRM 2.0 & Iper-Personalizzazione: Definire e implementare logiche di ingaggio cliente avanzate, orientate alla personalizzazione dell'esperienza e delle offerte.
Data Prep & Hands-on Coding: Curare direttamente la pulizia, la trasformazione e l'integrazione di dataset complessi da fonti eterogenee (CRM, POS, Web Analytics, Survey) tramite SQL avanzato e Python.
Modellistica Predittiva & Machine Learning: Progettare e sviluppare algoritmi di Churn Prevention, Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) e propensione al riacquisto (Repurchase / Next Best Action).
Segmentazione & Clustering: Sviluppare modelli di clustering non supervisionato per profilare la Customer Base globale.
Business Partnering & Storytelling: Tradurre analisi quantitative complesse in dashboard direzionali (Power BI/Tableau) e "raccomandazioni azionabili" per gli executive dei vari Paesi.
AI Generativa & LLM: Partecipare alla sperimentazione e all'integrazione di progetti innovativi di Generative AI applicati al CRM (es. Speech Analytics, Prompt Design).




Requisiti Richiesti

Formazione & Tracciato Professionale

Titolo di Studio:Laurea Magistrale in ambito STEM (Ingegneria, Matematica, Fisica, Statistica, Data Science).
Seniority:7+ anni di esperienza in ruoli di Customer Analytics / Data Science applicati al B2C.
Background Ideale: Percorso iniziale in consulenza con successivo passaggio in aziende B2C strutturate ad alto volume di dati




Competenze Tecniche & Linguistiche

Coding: Padronanza quotidiana di SQL avanzato e Python (Pandas, PySpark, Scikit-Learn).
Data Visualization: Ottima conoscenza di Power BI o Tableau.
Lingue:Inglese Fluente (C1/C2), indispensabile per la gestione quotidiana degli stakeholder internazionali.




Soft Skills

Eccellente capacità di storytelling dei dati e presenza relazionale di fronte a interlocutori non tecnici.
Approccio fortemente hands-on unito a visione strategica.
Capacità di coordinamento di team terzi e fornitori.




Dettagli Contrattuali

Sede di lavoro: Milano (HQ).
Inquadramento: Contratto a Tempo Indeterminato, Livello Quadro.
Work Mode: Ibrido (policy aziendale che prevede 6 giorni al mese di smart working).
Pacchetto retributivo: Target indicativo RAL €65.000 – €75.000 + MBO / Variabile.

Title: Risk Analytics & Data Science Senior Consultant - Risk Consulting
Description:
Risk Analytics & Data Science Senior Consultant – Risk Consulting

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Se cerchi un percorso di crescita in un contesto internazionale dove le tue idee contano davvero, sei nel posto giusto. In un contesto in cui l'intelligenza artificiale sta ridefinendo il modo di lavorare, crediamo che il vero valore nasca dalla capacità delle persone di interpretare la complessità, costruire relazioni di fiducia e trasformare le opportunità tecnologiche in impatto concreto per clienti, organizzazioni e società.

Perché candidarsi in EY?

Lo abbiamo chiesto a chi ci lavora già! Questi i fattori più influenti:


Investimento sulle competenze del futuro: In EY la tecnologia non sostituisce il contributo delle persone: lo amplifica. Per questo investiamo nello sviluppo di competenze, relazioni e capacità di giudizio che permettono di affrontare le sfide più complesse e generare valore sostenibile nel tempo. Fin dal primo giorno, avrai accesso a eventi, strumenti e corsi sull’Intelligenza Artificiale, per imparare a usare la tecnologia come leva per amplificare il tuo impatto.
Formazione continua: oltre 50 ore di corsi tecnici e manageriali all’anno previsti per ciascuna persona; per integrare apprendimento e lavoro quotidiano, trasformando ogni progetto in un’occasione di crescita.
Sviluppo e progressione di carriera: solo negli ultimi 12 mesi, oltre la metà delle persone di EY si è vista riconoscere un avanzamento di carriera; con percorsi in cui competenze, potenziale e contributo individuale diventano elementi centrali.

Title: AI & Data Science Engineer
Description:
Job Description

DXC Technology is looking for a Data Scientist to support AI and Generative AI projects, contributing to practical solutions and improving business processes through ML models, NLP and intelligent automation, within the Data & AI team based in Milan.

Key Responsibilities


Contribute to the design and implementation of AI solutions, including machine learning models, NLP, and computer vision applications
Collaborate with senior team members to understand client requirements and translate them into practical AI solutions
Support the direct relationship with clients/stakeholders for requirements gathering and solution validation
Support pre-sales activities, including preparing technical materials and contributing to client presentations
Stay up to date on AI trends and emerging technologies, applying knowledge to support solution development
Contribute to maintaining best practices and methodologies within the AI & Data Science team
Take part in AI solution projects, gaining hands-on experience in real client environments and progressively growing in autonomy.


Requirements


Proven experience in Gen AI projects.
Ability to translate business requirements into practical AI solutions, including design and implementation.
Deep expertise in core Generative AI technologies, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Prompt Engineering, Observability, and AI Guardrails.
Extensive experience with enterprise-grade GenAI development frameworks and platforms, including LangChain, LangGraph, LiteLLM, and Langfuse.
Proven experience in addressing AI governance, GDPR, and EU AI Act compliance requirements throughout the AI solution lifecycle.
Good knowledge of machine learning frameworks and libraries (Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, etc.)
Strong proficiency in AI-powered software development and code generation tools.
Extensive experience with enterprise software delivery practices and platforms, including source code management, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment frameworks.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Good communication skills and strong ability to work in a collaborative team.
Growing autonomy in managing assigned tasks and deliverables.
Ability to organize project activities by identifying priorities and ensuring deadlines are met


Nice to Have


Previous involvement in presales or solution support tasks


Location: Milan, with smart working possibility

Why Join Us

Offer Package

The position offers a gross annual base salary starting from €48.000

Compensation is determined in line with the applicable collective labor agreement (CBA: Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro per l'industria metalmeccanica e della installazione di impianti) and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including responsibility, experience and skills.


Health Insurance
Permanent disability by accident coverage
Life and permanent disability by accident coverage
Meal vouchers
Supplemental Pension Plan
Smart Working Agreement
Employee Discounts Program


Continuous Learning — Access learning platforms and take part in skill development programs designed for you.

Refer & Earn — Help us find great talent through the Employee Referral Program and get rewarded for your contribution.

Career Development — DXC promotes professional growth and internal mobility by making every open position accessible to all employees. Through the Performance Development program, the company supports individual aspirations to achieve shared goals together.

Our Way of Working — At DXC, we believe that strong connections and collaboration drive success. Our hybrid work model combines flexibility with in-person teamwork, empowering you to perform at your best while maintaining balance and wellbeing.

Title: Experienced – Data Scientist GenAI
Description:
Stiamo cercando una figura Senior Consultant da inserire nel team Digital, AI Controls & Algorithms per le sedi di Roma e Milano che lavorerà in modalità Hybrid.

L’area Digital, AI Controls & Algorithms è un’area di frontiera nell’utilizzo di tecnologie avanzate e si occupa di fornire servizi di Digital Transformation con l’obiettivo di supportare la digitalizzazione dei processi di business delle principali multinazionali clienti. Le attività prevedono l’utilizzo di strumenti di Generative AI, AI e Data Analytics, integrati all’interno di un ecosistema applicativo e infrastrutturale all’avanguardia (SOTA). Per questo, sfruttiamo i principali servizi offerti dai maggiori player del settore Cloud, oltre a soluzioni di deployment locali on-premise.

Your Role

La risorsa Experienced verrà inserita in un team di lavoro e si occuperà di:


Leadership Tecnologica: Assumere il ruolo di Team Leader, supervisionando e coordinando un team tecnico di sviluppo o consulenti junior con diverse expertise
Progettazione e Analisi Soluzioni AI & GenAI: Analizzare e progettare soluzioni GenAI, AI complesse, sia applicative che di integrazione con diversi sistemi
Gestione del Problem Solving: Affrontare e risolvere autonomamente problematiche tecniche articolate, mantenendo efficienza e precisione anche sotto pressione;
Collaborazione Internazionale: Operare all'interno di team numerosi e diversificati, con la possibilità di interagire su scala internazionale.


What We Offer

La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra EUR 33.000 e EUR 37.500 lordi annui per il grade Consultant, e tra EUR 40.000 e EUR 49.000 lordi annui per il grade Senior Consultant.

L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi.

La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.

Winning Requirements


Laurea in materie STEM;
Esperienza nella gestione end-to-end di progetti di Data Science: raccolta requisiti, progettazione, sviluppo e test di soluzioni AI e GenAI. In particolare è richiesta esperienza di almeno 5 anni nell’ambito dei progetti di AI/ML e 2 anni nell’ambito dei progetti di GenAI
Conoscenza dei principali foundation model (llama, gpt, sonnet etc.) e loro applicazione a seconda della specificità del progetto.
Esperienza pregressa nello sviluppo di applicazioni di Generative AI (langchain, llamaindex, ecc.) con sviluppo e rilascio in produzione di soluzioni RAG sia in modalità chatbot che non
Ottima conoscenza di Python e delle librerie per manipolazione dati e sviluppo modelli;
Esperienza con strumenti di containerizzazione (e.g. docker) e strumenti di versioning del codice (e.g. GIT)
Conoscenza di strumenti e linguaggi per la manipolazione dei dati: SQL, MongoDB, Neo4j, Spark, ecc.
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese;
Flessibilità, disponibilità a viaggiare.


To Make An Impact That Matters

Il network Deloitte, leader nei servizi professionali alle imprese, opera a livello globale in più di 150 Paesi con oltre 460 mila persone.

In Italia, Deloitte è presente in 24 città con circa 13.400 persone che assistono i clienti offrendo servizi di Audit & Assurance, Technology & Transformantion, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory e Tax & Legal.

In qualità di network globale ci impegniamo per affrontare le principali sfide sociali, economiche e ambientali della società di oggi. WorldImpact è il nostro programma globale che riunisce tutte le iniziative attraverso cui vogliamo avere un impatto positivo sulle persone, i clienti, l’ambiente e le comunità in cui operiamo.

Con Impact for Italy, la declinazione italiana di WorldImpact, Deloitte ha realizzato progetti che - in collaborazione con istituzioni, realtà del terzo settore, università e altri soggetti - hanno lasciato un impatto concreto e una legacy per il futuro su tutto il territorio nazionale.

La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006, il D.lgs. 215/03 e il D.lgs. 216/03 ed è aperta a candidat* di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.

Title: Experienced Professional | Data Scientist Manager
Description:
📍 Sede: Milano

👀 Rank: Manager




Chi siamo

JAKALA è un'azienda che lavora su dati, intelligenza artificiale e sviluppo di esperienze per generare un impatto significativo e duraturo a livello globale.

Presenti in oltre 30 città in 21 paesi, i nostri team uniscono competenze su strategia, tecnologia, creatività e operations per offrire esperienze personalizzate e soluzioni trasformative ai nostri clienti, grazie al supporto di dati e intelligenza artificiale. I Jakalers sono un gruppo eterogeneo di oltre 3.000 persone, animate da passione, ambizione e idee brillanti. Proprio questa combinazione unica di talenti è il fattore distintivo che ha ispirato il nostro purpose: Together to get there.

Creare un mondo migliore è il nostro obiettivo ultimo: la nostra ambizione è generare valore per tutti i nostri stakeholder in modo sostenibile, con particolare attenzione a etica, clima e qualità. Nel 2021, abbiamo scelto di diventare una Società Benefit, dimostrando il nostro impegno di lungo periodo e la volontà di proteggere i principi e i valori che ogni giorno guidano le nostre azioni.

Crediamo che la diversità sia la chiave del nostro successo e, per questo, siamo impegnati a creare un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, dove ciascuno possa sentirsi valorizzato per la propria unicità. Tutte le nostre opportunità di lavoro sono aperte ai candidati appartenenti alle categorie protette L.68/99.




Scopri il team

Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Data Science Manager con forte background tecnico e capacità di leadership, che guidi la delivery di progetti avanzati di data science e machine learning in ambito marketing e business analytics.

Sarai una figura chiave in grado di tradurre obiettivi di business e complessità degli ecosistemi dati in roadmap analitiche, interfacciandoti in prima persona con C-level, Marketing Director e stakeholder tecnici. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con Data Engineer, MarTech / Media Specialist e Account, con l'obiettivo comune di trasformare dati grezzi in strategie scalabili e soluzioni ad altissimo impatto per i brand.

Avrai inoltre la responsabilità di definire approcci analitici, supervisionare la qualità delle soluzioni sviluppate e contribuire attivamente alla crescita tecnica e professionale del team.




🎯 Le tue responsabilità:

Sarai il punto di riferimento per il cliente, guidando in modo proattivo presentazioni strategiche e momenti di avanzamento (SAL), con la capacità di tradurre modelli complessi e analisi avanzate in insight chiari e rilevanti anche per stakeholder non tecnici.
Lavorerai su grandi volumi di dati, interrogando e modellando dataset su Cloud Data Warehouse (es. BigQuery, Databricks) per generare insight concreti a supporto delle decisioni di business.
Definirai l’impianto di misurazione e guiderai lo sviluppo di modelli avanzati di Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) e attribuzione data-driven, contribuendo all’ottimizzazione di budget marketing complessi.
Progetterai soluzioni di machine learning e customer analytics (segmentazione, clustering, modelli di propensity, Customer Lifetime Value), pensate per essere attivate direttamente su piattaforme media e sistemi di marketing automation, con un forte focus su retention e audience strategy.
Coordinerai l’integrazione di fonti dati marketing eterogenee (advertising platform, CRM, CDP, dati web/app), trasformandole in un ecosistema dati coerente e funzionale alla crescita e all’efficienza.
Collaborerai in modo continuativo con team multidisciplinari (Media, CRO, IT, CRM, Account), fungendo da ponte tra competenze diverse e trasformando analisi complesse in strategie e azioni concrete.
Promuoverai l’adozione di soluzioni innovative, inclusi use case di Generative AI (LLM open source, OpenAI, Vertex AI) applicati al digital marketing, come automazione, personalizzazione avanzata e content intelligence.
Avrai un ruolo chiave nella crescita del team, definendo best practice, diffondendo la cultura del dato e supportando lo sviluppo professionale delle persone.




🙌 Se ti riconosci in queste caratteristiche, potremmo essere il perfetto match:

6+ anni di esperienza hands-on in Data Science e Advanced Analytics, preferibilmente maturata in contesti di consulenza strategico-tecnologica o in primarie realtà di agenzia digital/media.
Solido business acumen e forte standing consulenziale, con capacità di comunicare e presentare in modo chiaro ed efficace risultati complessi a stakeholder e decision maker enterprise.
Esperienza nell’estrazione, gestione e modellazione di dati in ambienti Cloud (es. Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Azure), con eccellente conoscenza di Python e SQL.
Esperienza pregressa in ruoli di responsabilità (team lead, tech lead o project lead), con gestione di risorse, priorità e delivery in contesti complessi e caratterizzati da SLA sfidanti.
Formazione accademica in discipline quantitative o ingegneristiche (Informatica, Matematica, Statistica, Ingegneria, Fisica o affini).
Familiarità con ecosistemi martech e adtech, in particolare architetture di digital marketing e tracking (es. GA4, piattaforme advertising, CDP, DMP, CRM e Big Data marketing stack).
Costituisce titolo preferenziale l’esperienza con framework avanzati di Marketing Mix Modeling (es. Robyn, Meridian) o con librerie bayesiane come PyMC o Stan.




💜 Scopri nel video le ragioni per cui scegliere JAKALA come prossimo step di carriera:

In JAKALA crediamo che il tempo e il benessere delle persone vadano rispettati, sempre: incoraggiamo una presenza in ufficio di 10 giorni al mese, lasciando piena libertà di lavorare da dove preferisci, sia in Italia che all’interno della Comunità Europea.
Il nostro sistema di Total Reward include convenzioni esclusive per viaggi, ristoranti, shopping, palestra e tempo libero, oltre a servizi gratuiti di telemedicina e supporto psicologico, pensati per te e per chi ami.
Investire nel nostro processo di selezione significa ricevere supporto autentico: un Recruiter dedicato ti accompagnerà con feedback personalizzati, consigli di carriera e insight sul tuo CV, a prescindere dall’esito della candidatura. Niente AI, solo persone. E, grazie all’iniziativa Your Time Back, ti restituiamo il tempo investito nei colloqui con un percorso di empowerment firmato Unobravo.




💰 Retribuzione:

Per questa posizione la RAL prevista è compresa tra 45.000 € e 65.000 € lordi annui. La proposta retributiva sarà definita all'interno di questa fascia in base all'esperienza, alle competenze maturate e al livello di seniority coerente con il ruolo, applicando criteri oggettivi e neutri sotto il profilo del genere. Si applica il CCNL Commercio – Terziario.

Title: AI Scientist
Description:
Build the science that shapes the future of human health.

Application closing date: 11.11.2026

Join a place where ambitious science thrives

Human Technopole (Milan) is a rapidly expanding life science institute where international researchers and cutting-edge technologies converge to accelerate biomedical discovery. Our mission is to transform bold scientific ideas into advances that improve human health.

Within this mission, the Casale Group in the Health Data Science Centre develops AI methods that transform population-scale human data into mechanistic models of disease. Our research integrates large-scale human genetics with molecular and clinical data to generate testable hypotheses that accelerate biological discovery and therapeutic innovation.

We are recruiting an ambitious AI Scientist to build the reusable AI foundations and agentic scientific systems that power the group’s research across human genetics, multimodal biology, and disease.

Your mission

As AI Scientist, you will develop next-generation AI systems at the interface of ambitious biological research and frontier artificial intelligence, using population-scale genetics and multimodal biomedical data to uncover mechanisms of human disease.

You will turn methods and models emerging from this research into robust, reusable AI capabilities—including foundation models, multimodal representation learning, agentic workflows, evaluation frameworks, and scalable research software—that can accelerate discovery across multiple projects.

A longer-term goal is to develop AI systems that increasingly act as scientific collaborators: connecting evidence across biological scales, proposing testable hypotheses, identifying informative analyses, and working alongside researchers to accelerate iterative cycles of biological discovery.

Your work will combine methodological innovation, biological discovery, and scientific software development at the intersection of artificial intelligence, computational biology, and human genetics. You will have substantial scientific and technical ownership, with the opportunity to help shape the group’s technical AI architecture while leading and contributing to high-impact scientific publications, open-source software, and reusable research capabilities.

As part of Human Technopole’s interdisciplinary AI ecosystem, you will engage closely with the European AI community, including through collaborations with Helmholtz Munich and connections to the ELLIS network. Your work will benefit from interactions with computational, biological, and clinical groups across the institute, alongside opportunities for international collaboration, research exchanges, interdisciplinary training, and engagement with industry.

You will also draw on the group’s established network across leading academic institutions and industry partners in Europe and North America, helping you build collaborations, broaden your expertise, and accelerate the impact of your research.

Grow Your Skills

You will enhance your scientific and professional skills by:


Developing next-generation AI methods through ambitious biological research.
Building foundation models, multimodal representation learning approaches, and agentic AI systems for scientific discovery.
Turning scientific advances into robust, benchmarked, and reusable AI capabilities that accelerate discovery across multiple research projects.
Building scalable research software and AI workflows for large and heterogeneous scientific datasets.
Shaping the future of AI for science through high-impact publications, open-source software, international collaborations, and entrepreneurial initiatives.


Human Technopole supports career development through training, mentoring and dedicated learning opportunities.

Essential

What you'll bring


PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Computational Biology, or a related quantitative discipline, or expected completion within the next six months.
At least 4 years of relevant research experience by the start of the position, including doctoral research.
Strong track record of scientific output in AI, machine learning, computational biology, or biomedicine, demonstrating independent methodological or technical contributions through publications, open-source software, models, or comparable research outputs.
Excellent programming and software engineering skills in Python, with experience building scalable and maintainable research software, model-training workflows, or AI systems.
Strong expertise in modern machine learning and AI, with demonstrated ability to design, develop, and critically evaluate advanced methods for challenging research problems.
Experience with modern software engineering and computational research practices, including version control, testing, documentation, reproducibility, and large-scale GPU or HPC environments.


Preferred


Industry or applied R&D experience in roles such as AI/ML architect, research scientist, machine learning scientist, or equivalent positions with substantial technical ownership.
Experience developing foundation models or other large-scale AI systems for scientific or biomedical applications.
Experience developing or applying LLM-based agents and agentic workflows for scientific or technical tasks, including analysis, information integration, automation, or hypothesis generation.
Experience integrating multimodal biomedical datasets, including molecular, imaging, clinical, or population-scale data.
Experience leading collaborative software projects and contributing to open-source scientific software or models.
Experience with workflow management, containerisation, and scalable GPU/HPC computing.
Familiarity with human genetics and computational biology is advantageous but not required.
Experience applying AI within drug discovery, translational research, or related biomedical pipelines is an advantage.


Organizational and social skills


Strong analytical thinking and scientific curiosity.
Ability to work independently while thriving in an interdisciplinary and collaborative environment.
Excellent communication and scientific writing skills.
Creativity, intellectual humility, and enthusiasm for tackling challenging biological questions.
Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to take ownership of ambitious research projects.


At HT, your discoveries contribute to a global effort to improve human health.

Why Human Technopole

HT offers an international and dynamic workplace, competitive welfare provisions, flexible working policies and relocation support. Candidates moving to Italy may benefit from attractive tax benefits. We promote work–life balance and provide parental support initiatives.

Title: (CDP)_Risk Data & Solutions Senior Specialist
Description:
Descrizione lavoro:



Cassa Depositi e Prestiti ricerca "Risk Data & Solutions Senior Specialist".

 

La persona verrà inserita all’interno della Direzione “Rischi”, nell'area Risk Data & Solutions e si occuperà delle seguenti attività: (i) creazione, manutenzione ed evoluzione modelli di elaborazione dati per la a verifica della qualità dei dati stessi, secondo l’approccio di sviluppo ed integrazione continua; (ii) creazione e/o porting, manutenzione ed evoluzione di procedure di elaborazione dati orientate ai vari ambiti della Direzione Rischi (e.g. compliance, anti-riciclaggio, valutazione e monitoraggio del credito, etc.); (iii) creazione, manutenzione ed evoluzione reportistica analitica interattiva mediante utilizzo dello stack Office (e.g. PowerBI) o Python / Web (e.g. Streamlit / Dash / Flask); (iv) ottimizzazione dell’elaborazione e dell’utilizzo di risorse cloud (e.g. Azure Data Factory, Logic Apps, Container Instance, Batch Instance); (v) integrazione tecniche preddittive di Machine Learning con focus sulla minimizzazione della varianza ed ottimizzazione dell’allineamento dei risultati; (vi) redazione e manutenzione della documentazione per la gestione del patrimonio informativo ed applicativo. 

 


Requisiti
La persona ideale ha conseguito una laurea in Discipline Tecnico – Scientifiche come Fisica/Matematica/Statistica/Ingegneria – gradito dottorato o titolo post lauream. La persona ha maturato almeno 3 anni di esperienza come Data Engineer/Scientist all'interno di contesti strutturati, con un forte interesse per temi di finanza, risk management, compliance. Il ruolo richiede la conoscenza di Sql, PySpark, Python, Pandas, NumPy, Stack Azure (e.g. Synapse, ADF, LogicApps), Stack Office365 (Power Apps, PowerBI), Streamlit/Dash/Flask, Pipelines CI/CD, Git. Stack LLM (e.g. OpenRouter, Azure ML/AI). Si richiede inoltre un inglese fluente. Completano il profilo dinamismo, proattività, flessibilità, disponibilità e agilità di apprendimento, spiccate capacità di problem solving.

 

Sede: Milano

Title: Global ML Engineering
Description:
Campari Group today is a major player in the global branded spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands, marketed and distributed in over 190 markets around the world, with leading positions in Europe and the Americas.

Headquartered in Milan, Italy, Campari Group owns 25 plants worldwide and has its own distribution network in 26 countries, and employs approximately 4,700 people.

Shares of the parent company Davide Campari - Milano N.V. are listed on the Italian Stock Exchange since 2001. Campari Group is today the sixth-largest player worldwide in the premium spirits industry.

Mission

The Global Machine Learning Engineer is responsible for accelerating the delivery, industrialisation and scaling of Machine Learning capabilities across Campari Group, with a particular focus on Revenue Growth Management, forecasting, pricing optimisation, promotional effectiveness and commercial analytics. The role transforms advanced analytical prototypes into robust, reusable and production-ready AI products that improve decision quality, increase automation, reduce external dependency and unlock measurable revenue, margin and operational efficiency benefits.

General Description Of The Role

Within the Technology & Services organization, the AI, Data & Analytics team, the Global Machine Learning Engineer is responsible for enabling data-driven decision making and accelerating business value through data, analytics and Artificial Intelligence capabilities.

The Global Machine Learning Engineer plays a critical role in designing, developing, deploying and maintaining machine learning models, optimisation engines and production-grade AI solutions that support strategic initiatives across Revenue Growth Management, demand forecasting, pricing optimisation, promotion effectiveness, sales planning and commercial decision-making.

The role bridges data science, data engineering, business stakeholders and technology platforms, ensuring that AI and ML models move from proof-of-concept into robust, secure, monitored and reusable products that can be deployed and adopted at global scale. The Machine Learning Engineer will contribute to MLOps practices, automated model retraining, model monitoring, explainability and governance, enabling sustainable adoption across markets and brands.

Key Responsibilities And Activities

Machine Learning Model Development


Design, develop, validate and maintain machine learning models supporting forecasting, pricing optimisation, promotion optimisation and commercial analytics use cases.
Develop scalable forecasting models across demand, sales and commercial planning processes, supporting improved business planning, S&OP effectiveness and decision quality.
Build optimisation engines and analytical models that support Revenue Growth Management decisions, including trade investment, promotional effectiveness and net sales performance opportunities.
Translate business needs into robust ML technical solutions, balancing accuracy, interpretability, usability and operational feasibility.


MLOps, Industrialisation & Productisation


Transform analytical prototypes and data science models into scalable, production-ready AI products that can be deployed, monitored and maintained globally.
Design and implement MLOps pipelines for automated model training, retraining, deployment, versioning, performance monitoring and lifecycle management.
Establish reusable model components, technical patterns and deployment accelerators that can be replicated across markets, brands and business functions.
Ensure production ML solutions are reliable, maintainable and aligned with enterprise architecture, security and operational standards.


RGM (Revenue Growth Management) & Forecasting Enablement


Support the industrialisation of AI-enabled RGM use cases, including price optimisation, promotion optimisation, trade investment decision support and predictive commercial insights.
Improve forecast accuracy by embedding advanced ML models in commercial and planning workflows.
Enable predictive and prescriptive analytics capabilities that move KPI usage beyond retrospective reporting and towards forward-looking decision support.
Collaborate with business teams to ensure ML solutions are adopted and embedded into relevant planning, commercial and performance management processes


AI Governance, Explainability & Model Monitoring


Support model explainability, transparency and governance requirements, ensuring business stakeholders can understand and trust model outputs.
Monitor model quality, drift, performance and adoption, recommending improvements and corrective actions when required.
Collaborate with Data Governance, Security, Enterprise Architecture and business stakeholders to ensure ML solutions comply with company standards and responsible AI principles.
Maintain documentation, controls and operating practices required for production-grade ML solutions.


Enterprise Integration & Automation


Integrate ML outputs into enterprise platforms, business workflows, dashboards and decision-support tools.
Collaborate with Data Platform, Data Engineering and Application teams to ensure the availability, quality and scalability of the data pipelines required by ML products.
Support automation of repetitive analytical activities, enabling business teams to focus on higher-value interpretation, planning and decision-making.
Contribute to Agentic AI scenarios where forecasting, optimisation and business workflows are connected through intelligent assistants and agents.


Stakeholder Partnership & Continuous Improvement


Partner with business stakeholders to prioritise ML use cases based on value, feasibility, scalability and strategic relevance.
Provide technical guidance to data scientists, analysts and business teams on ML engineering, deployment and maintainability considerations.
Stay informed about emerging machine learning, optimisation and MLOps technologies, assessing relevance for Campari Group priorities.
Contribute to building sustainable internal AI capabilities and reducing long-term dependency on external consultants and contractors.


Required Skills And Experience

Experience & Background


7+ years of experience in Machine Learning Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering or similar AI engineering roles.
Proven experience developing, deploying and maintaining machine learning models in production environments.
Experience with forecasting, optimisation, predictive modelling or commercial analytics use cases is strongly preferred.
Experience operating in complex, international business environments and working with cross-functional stakeholders.
Experience translating analytical prototypes into scalable products and reusable capabilities.


Machine Learning & Forecasting Skills


Strong knowledge of supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques, time-series forecasting, optimisation methods and model evaluation approaches.
Experience building demand forecasting, sales forecasting, pricing, promotion optimisation or decision-support models.
Understanding of model explainability, feature engineering, model monitoring and model performance management.
Ability to balance model accuracy with business interpretability, scalability and operational adoption.
Knowledge of AI-enabled decision-support capabilities in commercial, planning or supply chain contexts is considered a plus.


Technical & MLOps Skills


Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with common ML libraries and frameworks.
Hands-on experience with cloud-based AI and data platforms, preferably Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks or equivalent technologies.
Experience designing MLOps pipelines, CI/CD workflows, model registries, automated retraining, model monitoring and deployment automation.
Experience working with APIs, data pipelines, version control, containerisation and modern software engineering practices.
Understanding of data governance, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture and responsible AI principles.


Business Skills


Ability to translate business challenges into practical machine learning solutions and clearly communicate model outputs to non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and prioritisation skills, with a focus on measurable business value.
Ability to work closely with Commercial, RGM, Supply Chain, Finance, IT and Data & Analytics stakeholders.
Strong stakeholder management, collaboration and influencing skills.


Education


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics or related fields.
Relevant certifications in Machine Learning, Cloud, Data Engineering or MLOps are considered a plus.


Key Competencies


Strong analytical mindset and passion for machine learning, optimisation and business value creation.
Ability to combine technical excellence with pragmatic delivery and adoption focus.
Structured problem-solving approach and strong attention to quality, reliability and scalability.
Accountability and ownership mindset, with the ability to move solutions from prototype to production.
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-evolving and cross-functional environments.
Strong collaboration and stakeholder management across global teams and business functions.
Curiosity and continuous learning attitude towards new ML, AI and MLOps technologies.
Results-oriented approach focused on measurable improvements in revenue, margin, productivity and operational efficiency.
Strong communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts and model outcomes to business stakeholders.
Fluent English.


The indicative annual gross salary (base salary) for this position ranges within 55K-70K + 10% STI, depending on the candidate’s experience, skills, and overall profile.

The role is classified in accordance with the collective labor agreement – level 1

The position might also include a variable compensation component and a benefits package in line with applicable company policies

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:

At Campari Group we believe in building more value together, thus we see diversity in all forms as a source of enrichment. Our employment policies and practices ensure that we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment without regard to any individual’s race, religion, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or characteristics or expression, political affiliation or activity, age, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Campari Group believes that fair compensation and equal opportunities are crucial for employees’ well-being, empowerment, and engagement. Our efforts to ensure fair pay have earned us the Fair Pay Certification by Fair Pay Workplace, an independent organization dedicated to dismantling pay disparities based on gender, race and their intersection.

Your application will be assessed based on your abilities, expertise, general knowledge and experience, not because of any confidential, proprietary or trade secret information you may possess. You must not disclose to Campari Group any such information. In the event that you are asked a question that cannot be answered without disclosure of any confidential, proprietary or trade secret information (including from a current or prior employer or their vendors or customers), you must decline to answer the question.

Title: Advisory Analytics Manager - EMEA
Description:
Advisory Analytics Manager – EMEA

Aon exists to build decisions for the better — safeguarding and enriching the lives of people around the world. Our colleagues provide our clients in over 120 countries with advice and solutions that give them the clearness and confidence to make better decisions to protect and grow their business.

Our Analytics Team helps organisations make better workforce decisions by applying quantitative methods, statistical analysis, and sophisticated people analytics across human capital, compensation, and talent topics. Part of our work is supporting clients on compensation fairness, clearness in remuneration, and reward equity. We also help HR professionals and business leaders understand broader workforce dynamics and link talent outcomes to business performance.

Our division is a fast-growing area of advisory work: we combine Aon’s proprietary datasets with client data to answer strategic questions using meticulous analytical techniques, including pay equity modelling, segmentation, benchmarking, predictive modelling, driver analysis, and workforce diagnostics related to reward, talent acquisition, deployment, retention, workforce planning, and business performance.

Core Responsibilities


Interrogate large, sophisticated, and often imperfect client and proprietary datasets to identify workforce, reward, and talent patterns, including potential pay equity issues, data anomalies, and opportunities for evidence-based insight.
Lead or run elaborate analytics engagements from problem definition and data specification through data preparation, methodology selection, model development, validation, and interpretation of results across topics such as pay equity, pay transparency, workforce planning, reward analytics, and predictive people analytics.
Synthesise sophisticated quantitative outputs into clear narratives, translating statistical findings, pay equity diagnostics, model results, and benchmark comparisons into practical implications and recommendations for HR and organizational decision-makers.
Build analytically robust solutions to client issues by defining the data strategy, analytical framework, control factors where relevant, modelling approach, and required outputs, while balancing technical depth with commercial feasibility.
Demonstrate commercial leadership by understanding and interpreting client requirements related to compensation fairness, incentives, employee base, and people analytics. Craft these problems into compelling client proposals.


Qualifications And Experience That Will Lead To Success

As an Analytics Manager, your skills and experience will ideally include:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Mathematics; postgraduate training in analytics is profitable.
Experience with statistical methods and analytical techniques, such as regression analysis, hypothesis testing, segmentation, trend analysis.
Hands-on experience working with large and complicated HR, reward, compensation, and workforce datasets, ideally using Python, R, SQL, or analogous tools for data manipulation, analysis, and quality assurance.
Significant experience delivering analytical work in consulting and/or corporate analytics environments, ideally in pay equity, compensation, workforce, HR, or people analytics, with exposure to sophisticated client datasets and multi-country contexts.
Strong capability in data visualisation, dashboarding, and insight communication, including tools such as Tableau or Power BI, demonstrating skill in distilling pay equity, reward, and workforce analyses into clear and decision-useful outputs.
A meticulous and curious analytical mind, with strong attention to detail, good judgement on data limitations, and a proactive approach to solving technically and commercially intricate problems.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical methods, findings, and limitations clearly to non-technical interested parties and senior audiences.


The expected salary for the role is within an indicative range of €46,300.00 - €69,500.00, based

on the candidate's experience and seniority.

Title: Deep AI Native Software Engineering
Description:
YOU ARE

As an AI/ML Computational Scientist, you will design, build, and operationalize artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for enterprise clients, combining custom models with cloud and third-party AI services to deliver production-ready outcomes. Your role spans the full solution lifecycle — assessing client needs and data, selecting and customizing models (including Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models), designing scalable data and DevOps & MLOps pipelines for training and production, and ensuring quality, value, and reliability of deployed systems.

THE WORK



Formulate real-world problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and Machine Learning solutions

Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, models, and computational systems; design and build scalable data pipelines to support model training and production with DevOps & MLOps

Customize and apply Deep Learning and Gen AI models for various use cases based on the business needs, data availability, system and infrastructure requirements - including edge device and HPC

Engage in research and development of new AI and high-performance compute algorithms, models, and simulations along with their applications to solve complex business problems at client sites

Work with large-scale datasets and utilize data preprocessing techniques to ensure high-quality input for training and production

Implement and maintain efficient data storage and retrieval mechanisms for models and knowledge using appropriate tools

Justify the value of model approaches in business problems

Collaborate with teams from both business and technical sides, including users, use case representatives, business owners, engineers, architects, and UI designers, to achieve end-to-end project goals and integrate into production



EDUCATION



Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related field



Basic (required) Qualification



Work or coursework experience with machine learning engineering or machine learning science, deploying models in production at scale , including monitoring, alerting, automatic bug filing and auditing.

Experience (work or coursework) in applying theoretical foundations of computer science, including computer system architecture, system engineering, and programming



Preferred Qualification



Proficiency in Python and python-based AI/ML framework and familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)..

Experience working with language models like LLM's APIs and optimizing their usage for specific applications.

Experience with the following programming languages: Python, C++, Java, R, SQL

Strong written & verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Strong client-facing skillsets in a consulting environment

Strong cross-functional skills with the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and client-side teams

Entrepreneurial mindset with a curiosity and passion for emergent tech and driving innovation

Title: Data Engineer | Machine Learning
Description:
Per azienda IT innovativa che opera nel campo della computer vision e dell’AI applicata al mondo fisico, facente parte di una holding strutturata, si ricerca un profilo di Data Engineer.




Attraverso tecnologie proprietarie e completamente privacy-compliant, sviluppano soluzioni in grado di analizzare flussi di persone e veicoli in spazi reali, trasformando il mondo fisico in dati digitali utilizzabili per il business.




Posizione

Siamo alla ricerca di un Data & Analytics Engineer con 2–4 anni di esperienza, che voglia crescere in un contesto tech ad alta complessità e diventare un punto di riferimento per l’analisi dei dati e l’evoluzione dell’infrastruttura data. Il/La candidato/a entrerà a far parte del team Tech R&D e collaborerà a stretto contatto con i team Operations e Product, contribuendo in modo concreto alla valorizzazione del dato lungo tutto il suo ciclo di vita: raccolta, validazione, modellazione, analisi e reporting.




Responsabilità

La risorsa avrà responsabilità su:

Estrazione, trasformazione e validazione di dati provenienti da database relazionali (MS SQL, PostgreSQL) e non relazionali (Cassandra)
Analisi di dataset complessi, con particolare attenzione a dati di mobilità e dati spazio-temporali
Produzione di insight ad alto valore aggiunto a partire dai dati raccolti
Preparazione di analisi e reportistica per clienti, traducendo i risultati in raccomandazioni operative chiare ed efficaci
Presentazione dei risultati ai clienti e agli stakeholder interni
Progettazione e sviluppo di algoritmi per l’identificazione di pattern, anomalie, dati mancanti e trend rilevanti
Supporto alla progettazione, sviluppo e gestione di pipeline dati ETL/ELT in Python e Databricks




Requisiti

- Must have:

Ottima conoscenza di Python e dei principali strumenti/librerie per data analysis e data engineering, come Pandas, PySpark
Familiarità con la programmazione orientata agli oggetti
Ottima conoscenza di database relazionali SQL-based
Esperienza con database non relazionali, preferibilmente Cassandra
Capacità di realizzare analisi e insight e capacità di presentarle, sia nella preparazione del materiale, sia nell'esposizione orale dei risultati a clienti e stakeholder interni




- Nice to have:

2–4 anni di esperienza in ambito data analytics e/o data engineering
Esperienza nella progettazione o manutenzione di pipeline dati ETL/ELT
Conoscenza di strumenti di data visualization, come Plotly o Seaborn
Esperienza nell’analisi di dati a forte componente spazio-temporale, come serie storiche, dati geolocalizzati o dati di mobilità
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata
Familiarità con ambienti cloud




Altre Informazioni

Sede: Milano, zona MM Precotto
Modalità di lavoro: ibrida
Range RAL: 35K-43K
Smart Working

Title: Postdoc in Statistical Genetics Casale Group
Description:
Build the science that shapes the future of human health.

Application closing date: 04.11.2026

Join a place where ambitious science thrives

Human Technopole (Milan) is a rapidly expanding life science institute where international researchers and cutting-edge technologies converge to accelerate biomedical discovery. Our mission is to transform bold scientific ideas into advances that improve human health.

Within this mission, the Casale Group in the Health Data Science Centre develops AI methods that transform population-scale human data into mechanistic models of disease. Our research integrates large-scale human genetics with molecular and clinical data to generate testable hypotheses that accelerate biological discovery and therapeutic innovation.

We are recruiting an ambitious Postdoc in Statistical Genetics to shape our strategy for using human genetics as a causal anchor to understand disease mechanisms across biological scales.

Your mission

As Postdoc in Statistical Genetics, you will develop computational methods that connect human genetic variation to biological function. Using population-scale human genetics together with single-cell, spatial, and multimodal molecular data, you will identify the cells, cellular states, and biological programs through which genetic variation influences disease.

Your work will sit at the intersection of statistical genetics, machine learning, and mechanistic biology, with opportunities to lead methodological innovation and drive high-impact biological discoveries.

The role will give you access to population-scale human genetics, rich multimodal molecular and clinical datasets, and world-class AI and experimental research environments. This combination provides a unique foundation for ambitious research and enables biological questions to be explored at unprecedented scale.

As part of Human Technopole’s interdisciplinary AI ecosystem, you will engage closely with the European AI community, including through collaborations with Helmholtz Munich and connections to the ELLIS network. Your work will benefit from interactions with computational, biological, and clinical groups across the institute, alongside opportunities for international collaboration, research exchanges, interdisciplinary training, and engagement with industry.

You will also draw on the group’s established network across leading academic institutions and industry partners in Europe and North America, helping you build collaborations, broaden your expertise, and accelerate the impact of your research.

Grow Your Skills

You will enhance your scientific and professional skills by:


Developing next-generation methods integrating human genetics and multimodal biology.
Driving biological discovery across population-scale, molecular, and clinical data.
Building an internationally recognized research profile through top publications and conferences.
Shaping the future of AI for science across academia, industry, and entrepreneurship.


Essential

What you'll bring


PhD in Statistical Genetics, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Biostatistics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative discipline, or expected to be completed within the next six months.
Strong publication record in leading computational biology, genetics, or biomedical journals. Ideally, your work has focused on developing computational methods motivated by biological questions using population-scale human genetics or multimodal molecular data.
Excellent programming skills in Python.
Strong foundation in statistical genetics and quantitative methods for analysing large-scale genetic and molecular data, with familiarity with modern machine learning approaches.


Preferred


Experience with GWAS, biobanks, or population-scale genetics.
Experience with single-cell, spatial transcriptomics, or functional genomics.
Experience developing research software for large-scale genomic or molecular datasets
Background in Bayesian statistics, causal inference, or probabilistic modelling.
Familiarity with modern AI architectures and foundation models.


Organizational and social skills


Strong analytical thinking and scientific curiosity.
Ability to work independently while thriving in an interdisciplinary and collaborative environment.
Excellent communication and scientific writing skills.
Creativity, intellectual humility, and enthusiasm for tackling challenging biological questions.
Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to take ownership of ambitious research projects.


Why Human Technopole

HT offers an international and dynamic workplace, competitive welfare provisions, flexible working policies and relocation support. Researchers moving to Italy benefit from attractive tax benefits. We promote work–life balance and provide parental support initiatives.

Submit

How to apply


CV
Motivation letter

This is a fixed-term 3-year contract, offered under CCNL Chimico Farmaceutico, level B2.

Expected start date: January 2027.

Salary: up to € 43k.

Build the science that shapes the future of human health.

Application closing date: 04.11.2026

Join a place where ambitious science thrives

Human Technopole (Milan) is a rapidly expanding life science institute where international researchers and cutting-edge technologies converge to accelerate biomedical discovery. Our mission is to transform bold scientific ideas into advances that improve human health.

Within this mission, the Casale Group in the Health Data Science Centre develops AI methods that transform population-scale human data into mechanistic models of disease. Our research integrates large-scale human genetics with molecular and clinical data to generate testable hypotheses that accelerate biological discovery and therapeutic innovation.

We are recruiting an ambitious Postdoc in Statistical Genetics to shape our strategy for using human genetics as a causal anchor to understand disease mechanisms across biological scales.

Your mission

As Postdoc in Statistical Genetics, you will develop computational methods that connect human genetic variation to biological function. Using population-scale human genetics together with single-cell, spatial, and multimodal molecular data, you will identify the cells, cellular states, and biological programs through which genetic variation influences disease.

Your work will sit at the intersection of statistical genetics, machine learning, and mechanistic biology, with opportunities to lead methodological innovation and drive high-impact biological discoveries.

The role will give you access to population-scale human genetics, rich multimodal molecular and clinical datasets, and world-class AI and experimental research environments. This combination provides a unique foundation for ambitious research and enables biological questions to be explored at unprecedented scale.

As part of Human Technopole’s interdisciplinary AI ecosystem, you will engage closely with the European AI community, including through collaborations with Helmholtz Munich and connections to the ELLIS network. Your work will benefit from interactions with computational, biological, and clinical groups across the institute, alongside opportunities for international collaboration, research exchanges, interdisciplinary training, and engagement with industry.

You will also draw on the group’s established network across leading academic institutions and industry partners in Europe and North America, helping you build collaborations, broaden your expertise, and accelerate the impact of your research.

Grow Your Skills

You will enhance your scientific and professional skills by:

  • Developing next-generation methods integrating human genetics and multimodal biology.
  • Driving biological discovery across population-scale, molecular, and clinical data.
  • Building an internationally recognized research profile through top publications and conferences.
  • Shaping the future of AI for science across academia, industry, and entrepreneurship.

Essential

What you'll bring

  • PhD in Statistical Genetics, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Biostatistics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative discipline, or expected to be completed within the next six months.
  • Strong publication record in leading computational biology, genetics, or biomedical journals. Ideally, your work has focused on developing computational methods motivated by biological questions using population-scale human genetics or multimodal molecular data.
  • Excellent programming skills in Python.
  • Strong foundation in statistical genetics and quantitative methods for analysing large-scale genetic and molecular data, with familiarity with modern machine learning approaches.

Preferred

  • Experience with GWAS, biobanks, or population-scale genetics.
  • Experience with single-cell, spatial transcriptomics, or functional genomics.
  • Experience developing research software for large-scale genomic or molecular datasets
  • Background in Bayesian statistics, causal inference, or probabilistic modelling.
  • Familiarity with modern AI architectures and foundation models.

Organizational and social skills

  • Strong analytical thinking and scientific curiosity.
  • Ability to work independently while thriving in an interdisciplinary and collaborative environment.
  • Excellent communication and scientific writing skills.
  • Creativity, intellectual humility, and enthusiasm for tackling challenging biological questions.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to take ownership of ambitious research projects.

Per la nostra sede di Milano – Piazza Trento siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire come AI Developer all’interno del team “AI Factory”. La struttura ha lo scopo di presidiare lo sviluppo e la configurazione di soluzioni AI.

Per quale Società 

A2A Life Ventures. A2A Life Ventures nasce dall’esperienza e dalla visione innovativa del Gruppo A2A per supportare le Business Unit nell’accelerare la transizione energetica e ambientale. Evolutasi dal polo di innovazione del Gruppo in una piattaforma integrata di venture capital, venture building, sviluppo tecnologico, AI e partnership strategiche, opera come motore di crescita per nuove soluzioni ad alto potenziale. Trasforma idee e tecnologie emergenti in soluzioni ad alto impatto, creando valore per il Gruppo, per il mercato e per i territori. Un ecosistema aperto che connette ricerca, industria e startup per anticipare le sfide della sostenibilità e favorire la nascita di nuovi modelli industriali.

Ti occuperai di


Sviluppo Agentico e Generativo: progettare e implementare applicazioni basate su Agentic AI e architetture RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), orchestrando modelli LLM per interagire con database e sistemi aziendali
Ciclo di Vita del Modello (End-to-End): gestire l'intero workflow, dallo sviluppo di modelli di Machine Learning (Supervised/Unsupervised) e Deep Learning, fino alla loro integrazione in microservizi tramite API REST/gRPC
Predictive Maintenance & Asset Optimization: disegnare, sviluppare e mettere in produzione modelli e agenti di AI per monitorare gli asset di A2A (idroelettrico, termico, reti idriche, …), prevenendo guasti e ottimizzando i cicli di manutenzione
AI Governance & Ethics: assicurare che le soluzioni sviluppate rispettino i criteri di sicurezza, factuality (accuratezza dei fatti) e allineamento etico del Gruppo


Sei la persona giusta se ti riconosci in questo profilo



Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Matematica, Fisica, Data Science

Esperienza pregressa di 4-5 anni in ruolo analogo 

Core Coding: eccellente padronanza di Python e del suo ecosistema scientifico (NumPy, Pandas)

Framework ML/DL: esperienza consolidata con PyTorch, TensorFlow e librerie di boosting come XGBoost.

Modern AI Stack: conoscenza pratica di framework sviluppo agenti e gestione di Vector DB 

Cloud: esperienza nell'utilizzo di servizi AI su piattaforme Cloud (AWS, Azure o GCP)

Data Architecture: padronanza di SQL (PostgreSQL) e logiche NoSQL

Conoscenza dei principi di sicurezza applicati ai dati e ai modelli linguistici (es. prevenzione del prompt injection)

Capacità di scomporre processi aziendali complessi in task tecnologici eseguibili

Attenzione alla qualità del codice, i test di validazione e la manutenibilità a lungo termine



Che cosa offriamo 




Qualifica: Impiegato


Contratto Collettivo Nazionale per i lavoratori addetti al settore Elettrico 


Retribuzione: è prevista una Retribuzione Annua Lorda tra 42.000 € e 50.000 €.


Premio di risultato aziendale, con la possibilità, a discrezione del dipendente, di conversione in welfare o trasferibile al fondo di pensione integrativa con un contributo aggiuntivo da parte dell’azienda.


Performance Management: partecipazione al processo di Performance Management in ottica di miglioramento continuo delle prestazioni e con focus sulla crescita delle persone, grazie a feedback anche da persone diverse dal proprio manager, alla possibilità di indicare le proprie aspettative per il futuro e all’identificazione di Azioni di Sviluppo 


Pasti: Buoni pasto elettronici


A2A Life Sharing: Piano di Azionariato Diffuso del Gruppo A2A che prevede l’assegnazione di azioni ordinarie di A2A con la possibilità di beneficiare di ulteriori azioni nel tempo 


A2A Life Caring: A2A Life Caring, iniziativa a supporto della genitorialità attraverso un mese aggiuntivo retribuito al 100% per maternità/paternità, rimborsi spese per figli, convenzioni con asili nido


Risparmio e tempo libero: oltre 300 convenzioni, tra cui trasporti pubblici, attività sportive, viaggi, eventi culturali, e offerte speciali per luce e gas. Opzioni per il car sharing e la conversione del premio di risultato in benefit di welfare


Che cosa ti aspetta in A2A 




Flessibilità: settimana lavorativa con venerdì a orario ridotto, flessibilità negli orari di entrata/uscita e pausa pranzo


Smartworking sino al 60% dell’orario di lavoro su base bimestrale


Salute e benessere: assistenza sanitaria integrativa, supporto psicologico attraverso counseling, webinar dedicati al benessere psicofisico e vaccino antinfluenzale


Famiglia/Welfare team coaching per neogenitori; spazio caregiver, offriamo webinar e uno spazio di ascolto dedicati a chi si prende cura di persone fragili o non autosufficienti


Formazione e sviluppo: programma di induction dedicato ai nuovi assunti, gestione dei talenti, corsi di formazione e possibilità di crescita interna e job rotation tramite candidatura interna


Ambiente di lavoro: promuoviamo una cultura che valorizza la diversità, l’equità e l'inclusione (DE&I); potrai inoltre avere la possibilità di unirti ad un team dedicato allo sviluppo di iniziative e progetti su queste tematiche. Sosteniamo l'evoluzione tecnologica e offriamo strumenti e risorse per promuovere il lavoro digitale.


Saranno valutate esclusivamente le candidature inviate tramite il Sito Carriere aziendale.

Ci impegniamo ogni giorno per creare un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e innovativo, fondato sul rispetto, sull’etica e sulle pari opportunità garantendo la valorizzazione delle diversità.

Title: Tech Architect - ML & AI Engineer | Advanced Analytics
Description:
Tech Architect ML & AI Engineer | Advanced Analytics

Sedi: Roma, Milano, Bologna, Torino, Napoli, Padova

In Avanade siamo alla ricerca di Machine Learning & AI Engineer appassionati di Intelligenza Artificiale e innovazione, con almeno 5/6 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale in contesti aziendali strutturati; competenze di people management.

Entrerai a far parte del team Advanced Analytics, all’interno dell’area Data & AI, e contribuirai alla progettazione e allo sviluppo di progetti di Data Science, tra cui modelli predittivi, soluzioni basate su Large Language Models (LLM), agenti intelligenti e sistemi di Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

Together we do what matters.

Cosa Farai


Collaborerai con altri ML & AI Engineers, sviluppatori full stack AI, data engineers e solution architects per integrare modelli ML/AI in architetture cloud moderne.
Scriverai codice Python/PySpark di alta qualità e SQL per l’analisi e la trasformazione dei dati.
Lavorerai con modelli tradizionali di Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
Svilupperai soluzioni basate su Large Language Models, con conoscenza di tecnologie come RAG e agenti intelligenti.
Progetterai e svilupperai pipeline di ML e soluzioni AI, dalla fase di prototipazione alla messa in produzione
Utilizzerai strumenti di MLOps e DevOps per la gestione, versionamento e deployment dei modelli.
Contribuirai al confronto con i clienti, traducendo esigenze di business in soluzioni AI efficaci.


Qualifications

Competenze ed esperienze:

Il Profilo Ideale Possiede Buona Parte Delle Seguenti Competenze


Solida conoscenza di Python per il Machine Learning e la Data Science.
Solida conoscenza di SQL e modellazione dei dati.
Esperienza con librerie di Machine Learning (es. Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, Prophet).
Esperienza con i framework di Deep Learning (es. PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras).
Familiarità con strumenti di MLOps (es. MLFlow).
Esperienza con Large Language Models, tecniche di prompting e sistemi di Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Esperienza con piattaforme e servizi Cloud Microsoft come Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Fabric e/o Databricks (ML/GenAI).
Conoscenza delle pratiche di versionamento con Git, testing, CI/CD.
competenze di people management


Nice To Have


Esperienza con i principali framework per LLM come LangChain, LangGraph e LlamaIndex.
Esperienza con LLM open-source (LLaMA, Mistral, Mixtral) e tecniche di ottimizzazione (LoRA, fine-tuning).
Esperienza con Hugging Face Transformers.
Esperienza con servizi come AI Foundry.
Esperienza in deployment di modelli AI su infrastrutture containerizzate (Docker, Kubernetes).
Certificazioni rilevanti in ambito AI/ML, tra cui:
Microsoft: AZ-900, AI-900, AI-102, AI-100, DP-100, DP-600
Databricks: Machine Learning Associate, Machine Learning ---Professional, Databricks Certified GenAI Practitioner


Il Tuo Profilo


Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science o discipline affini.
Analitico, curioso, agile, paziente e orientato alla qualità
Capacità di lavorare in team cross-funzionali e di comunicare efficacemente con stakeholder tecnici e non.
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata.


Vivi al meglio la tua carriera: 

In Avanade troverai un'azienda meritocratica che investe sulla crescita delle persone attraverso percorsi di studio mirati e che prevedono una continua formazione - grazie alle partnership privilegiate con Microsoft e con alcuni dei più importanti player del settore - e il conseguimento di numerose certificazioni. 

Il luogo ideale in cui lavorare: 

Il nostro ambiente di lavoro è aperto e inclusivo, potrai quindi esprimere le tue idee e lavorare a progetti innovativi attraverso l’ultima tecnologia disponibile sul mercato, confrontarti con migliaia di consulenti in Italia e nel mondo. Inoltre, potrai godere di programmi di flexible e smart-working e di benefit personalizzati in base alle tue esigenze professionali e individuali, che comprendono agevolazioni, servizi e piani di corporate Well-Being. Scopri e dai un'occhiata più da vicino qui! 

Retribuzione

La retribuzione in Avanade varia in base a un’ampia gamma di fattori, tra cui, ad esempio, il ruolo, il livello di seniority, il grado di responsabilità, le competenze e l’esperienza maturata. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 1/ Quadro del Contratto Collettivo Nazionale per i dipendenti da aziende del terziario, distribuzione e servizi e la fascia di retribuzione base prevista è compresa tra € 41.000 a € 56.500.

Ulteriori informazioni: 

Per saperne di più, dai un'occhiata ai nostri blog: 


 Inclusion & Diversity; 
 Avanade Stories; 
 Avanade Insights. 


Se pensi che questa possa essere l'opportunità giusta per te, come and join us!

Title: Air quality modeler
Description:
Contract type

Regular / Permanent

Who are we?

SUEZ is a world leader in smart and sustainable resource management, and our Air & Climate unit provides consulting services and develop and deploy digital solutions that address the key environmental needs of our customers.

ARIANET, the Air & Climate unit in Italy, delivers studies, develops, designs, installs and manages cutting-edge solutions related to air quality management: diagnostic, real-time monitoring, forecast and scenario studies, for a proven customer base of industries, public and para-public entities.

To provide the best environmental solutions for our customers, we are strengthening our applied modeling team which performs studies and develops and manage simulation systems in industrial and urban areas.

In This Context, We Are Looking For An

Air quality modeler

Your mission

You will join the ARIANET team, and you will be involved in atmospheric modelling, concerning mainly dispersion, chemical transformation and ground deposition of pollutants at regional and urban scales.

You will mainly use a simulation system including meteorological and emission models and based on FARM (Flexible Air Quality Regional Model) chemical-transport model, developed by ARIANET in collaboration with national and international research centers and with a significant user base.

You will contribute to the multiple applications of the system, typically: operational forecast of ambient air quality, yearly air quality assessments, reconstruction of past events, estimation of sources contributions, scenario studies in support of policy planning and impact assessment studies. These activities will also include drafting the relevant technical reports and presenting the results to clients, mostly public but also private.

You will progressively participate in the development of the models’ new features, documenting them.

You will also be able to actively participate in research activities carried out within European projects and to contribute to the drafting of scientific publications.

Your profile

You Are The One If You


have a master's degree in physics, engineering, environmental sciences, or related disciplines
possess basic knowledge of atmospheric physics and/or meteorology, acquired through university courses or documented post-graduate experience
have 2-4 years’ work experience in the field of atmospheric modelling
have a good command of Unix/Linux environments and of Fortran or Python programming languages
have good knowledge of the English language and good writing skills
have a strong motivation and interest in actively working in the environmental field
have good analytical and communication skills
can work independently while coordinating within a team


Skills

Following proven expertise and skills are a strong plus:

PhD in meteorology, atmospheric physics or chemistry, natural sciences, environmental engineering

experience with numerical modeling and scientific programming

high-performance computing environments, parallelization and optimization of computational codes

use of machine-learning in support of quantitative analyses and modelling in environmental field

use of GIS for environmental applications

CFD modelling

Conditions

Full-time job.

Place of work: Milano.

Salary: 32-38 k€ yearly gross (excluding bonus), commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate.

SUEZ encourages and values diversity in gender, ethnicity, generation, culture, health, physical condition, sexual orientation, etc.

BU: International - Europe

CATEGORY: Skilled Employees

You will join the ARIANET team, and you will be involved in atmospheric modelling, concerning mainly dispersion, chemical transformation and ground deposition of pollutants at regional and urban scales.

You will mainly use a simulation system including meteorological and emission models and based on FARM (Flexible Air Quality Regional Model) chemical-transport model, developed by ARIANET in collaboration with national and international research centers and with a significant user base.

You will contribute to the multiple applications of the system, typically: operational forecast of ambient air quality, yearly air quality assessments, reconstruction of past events, estimation of sources contributions, scenario studies in support of policy planning and impact assessment studies. These activities will also include drafting the relevant technical reports and presenting the results to clients, mostly public but also private.

You will progressively participate in the development of the models’ new features, documenting them.

You will also be able to actively participate in research activities carried out within European projects and to contribute to the drafting of scientific publications.

Your profile

You Are The One If You

  • have a master's degree in physics, engineering, environmental sciences, or related disciplines
  • possess basic knowledge of atmospheric physics and/or meteorology, acquired through university courses or documented post-graduate experience
  • have 2-4 years’ work experience in the field of atmospheric modelling
  • have a good command of Unix/Linux environments and of Fortran or Python programming languages
  • have good knowledge of the English language and good writing skills
  • have a strong motivation and interest in actively working in the environmental field
  • have good analytical and communication skills
  • can work independently while coordinating within a team

Skills

 Following proven expertise and skills are a strong plus:

PhD in meteorology, atmospheric physics or chemistry, natural sciences, environmental engineering

experience with numerical modeling and scientific programming

high-performance computing environments, parallelization and optimization of computational codes

use of machine-learning in support of quantitative analyses and modelling in environmental field

use of GIS for environmental applications

CFD modelling

Conditions

Full-time job.

Place of work: Milano.

Salary: 32-38 k€ yearly gross (excluding bonus), commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate.

BU: International - Europe
