Title: CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE & CRM INSIGHTS SR SPECIALIST
Description:
Il nostro cliente è una primaria multinazionale italiana leader globale nel settore Retail & Healthcare, con una presenza capillare in oltre 25 Paesi e un network di migliaia di punti vendita a livello internazionale.

Per il potenziamento del proprio Global Center of Expertise (CoE) presso l'Headquarter di Milano, siamo alla ricerca di un Customer Intelligence & CRM Insights Sr Specialist / Manager.




Descrizione del Ruolo

La risorsa inserita sarà il punto di riferimento analitico e strategico per l'evoluzione del CRM 2.0 su scala globale, orientato all'iper-personalizzazione.

Rispondendo all'Associate Director Global CRM e lavorando all'interno di un team strutturato e dinamico, la figura opererà come Business Partner di livello globale, coordinando risorse esterne/consulenti e affiancando direttamente i Country Manager e Marketing Director delle varie filiali estere nella traduzione dei dati in leve di business.




Responsabilità Chiave

CRM 2.0 & Iper-Personalizzazione: Definire e implementare logiche di ingaggio cliente avanzate, orientate alla personalizzazione dell'esperienza e delle offerte.
Data Prep & Hands-on Coding: Curare direttamente la pulizia, la trasformazione e l'integrazione di dataset complessi da fonti eterogenee (CRM, POS, Web Analytics, Survey) tramite SQL avanzato e Python.
Modellistica Predittiva & Machine Learning: Progettare e sviluppare algoritmi di Churn Prevention, Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) e propensione al riacquisto (Repurchase / Next Best Action).
Segmentazione & Clustering: Sviluppare modelli di clustering non supervisionato per profilare la Customer Base globale.
Business Partnering & Storytelling: Tradurre analisi quantitative complesse in dashboard direzionali (Power BI/Tableau) e "raccomandazioni azionabili" per gli executive dei vari Paesi.
AI Generativa & LLM: Partecipare alla sperimentazione e all'integrazione di progetti innovativi di Generative AI applicati al CRM (es. Speech Analytics, Prompt Design).




Requisiti Richiesti

Formazione & Tracciato Professionale

Titolo di Studio:Laurea Magistrale in ambito STEM (Ingegneria, Matematica, Fisica, Statistica, Data Science).
Seniority:7+ anni di esperienza in ruoli di Customer Analytics / Data Science applicati al B2C.
Background Ideale: Percorso iniziale in consulenza con successivo passaggio in aziende B2C strutturate ad alto volume di dati




Competenze Tecniche & Linguistiche

Coding: Padronanza quotidiana di SQL avanzato e Python (Pandas, PySpark, Scikit-Learn).
Data Visualization: Ottima conoscenza di Power BI o Tableau.
Lingue:Inglese Fluente (C1/C2), indispensabile per la gestione quotidiana degli stakeholder internazionali.




Soft Skills

Eccellente capacità di storytelling dei dati e presenza relazionale di fronte a interlocutori non tecnici.
Approccio fortemente hands-on unito a visione strategica.
Capacità di coordinamento di team terzi e fornitori.




Dettagli Contrattuali

Sede di lavoro: Milano (HQ).
Inquadramento: Contratto a Tempo Indeterminato, Livello Quadro.
Work Mode: Ibrido (policy aziendale che prevede 6 giorni al mese di smart working).
Pacchetto retributivo: Target indicativo RAL €65.000 – €75.000 + MBO / Variabile.

Siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire in un team specializzato lato Enterprise Risk, con competenze verticali su Business Intelligence, Data Science e Risk Analytics, ed esperienza nell'applicazione di metodologie analitiche avanzate per supportare il monitoraggio e la gestione dei rischi aziendali. La figura sarà coinvolta nella progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni data-driven a supporto dei processi decisionali, combinando competenze quantitative, capacità di analisi e conoscenza dei principali framework di Risk & Compliance Management.

definizione, monitoraggio e gestione di KPI e Key Risk Indicators (KRI) evoluti;
sviluppo di indicatori predittivi ed Early Warning Systems per il monitoraggio continuo dei rischi;
costruzione di modelli di scoring, classificazione e valutazione del rischio.
realizzazione di dashboard direzionali e strumenti di Business Intelligence a supporto delle decisioni manageriali;
sviluppo di modelli analitici avanzati basati su tecniche statistiche, Machine Learning e Predictive Analytics;
analisi delle relazioni tra rischi mediante approcci di Risk Network Analysis e Graph Analytics;
collaborazione con stakeholder business, Risk e Compliance per tradurre esigenze operative in modelli quantitativi e strumenti analitici;
sviluppo e manutenzione di data pipeline e processi automatizzati per l'elaborazione e l'analisi dei dati;

esperienza di 2/3 anni nella progettazione di dashboard executive, nello sviluppo di modelli predittivi, forecasting, anomaly detection e sistemi decisionali data-driven.
buone conoscenze lato BI & Data Visualization, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics e modelli probabilistici; ottima conoscenza di Python e SQL
capacità di tradurre esigenze di Risk e Compliance Management in modelli quantitativi e strumenti operativi fruibili dal business.

costituiscono titolo preferenziale esperienze maturate in contesti di Risk Management, Fraud Management, Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) o AI Governance.

Accelerare le tue competenze: grazie a programmi di sviluppo orientati al futuro e a strumenti AI che automatizzano attività ripetitive, potrai dedicare più tempo all'analisi, alla consulenza, all'innovazione e alla costruzione di relazioni professionali ad alto impatto.

Avrai infine l’opportunità di:


accedere a benefits e programmi di welfare aziendale diversificati;
partecipare a programmi di leadership.

Per la specifica posizione è previsto un bonus al raggiungimento di obiettivi preventivamente comunicati e concordati.

Avrai infine l’opportunità di:

Title: Experienced – Data Scientist GenAI
Description:
Stiamo cercando una figura Senior Consultant da inserire nel team Digital, AI Controls & Algorithms per le sedi di Roma e Milano che lavorerà in modalità Hybrid.

L’area Digital, AI Controls & Algorithms è un’area di frontiera nell’utilizzo di tecnologie avanzate e si occupa di fornire servizi di Digital Transformation con l’obiettivo di supportare la digitalizzazione dei processi di business delle principali multinazionali clienti. Le attività prevedono l’utilizzo di strumenti di Generative AI, AI e Data Analytics, integrati all’interno di un ecosistema applicativo e infrastrutturale all’avanguardia (SOTA). Per questo, sfruttiamo i principali servizi offerti dai maggiori player del settore Cloud, oltre a soluzioni di deployment locali on-premise.

Your Role

La risorsa Experienced verrà inserita in un team di lavoro e si occuperà di:


Leadership Tecnologica: Assumere il ruolo di Team Leader, supervisionando e coordinando un team tecnico di sviluppo o consulenti junior con diverse expertise
Progettazione e Analisi Soluzioni AI & GenAI: Analizzare e progettare soluzioni GenAI, AI complesse, sia applicative che di integrazione con diversi sistemi
Gestione del Problem Solving: Affrontare e risolvere autonomamente problematiche tecniche articolate, mantenendo efficienza e precisione anche sotto pressione;
Collaborazione Internazionale: Operare all'interno di team numerosi e diversificati, con la possibilità di interagire su scala internazionale.


What We Offer

La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra EUR 33.000 e EUR 37.500 lordi annui per il grade Consultant, e tra EUR 40.000 e EUR 49.000 lordi annui per il grade Senior Consultant.

L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi.

La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.

Winning Requirements


Laurea in materie STEM;
Esperienza nella gestione end-to-end di progetti di Data Science: raccolta requisiti, progettazione, sviluppo e test di soluzioni AI e GenAI. In particolare è richiesta esperienza di almeno 5 anni nell’ambito dei progetti di AI/ML e 2 anni nell’ambito dei progetti di GenAI
Conoscenza dei principali foundation model (llama, gpt, sonnet etc.) e loro applicazione a seconda della specificità del progetto.
Esperienza pregressa nello sviluppo di applicazioni di Generative AI (langchain, llamaindex, ecc.) con sviluppo e rilascio in produzione di soluzioni RAG sia in modalità chatbot che non
Ottima conoscenza di Python e delle librerie per manipolazione dati e sviluppo modelli;
Esperienza con strumenti di containerizzazione (e.g. docker) e strumenti di versioning del codice (e.g. GIT)
Conoscenza di strumenti e linguaggi per la manipolazione dei dati: SQL, MongoDB, Neo4j, Spark, ecc.
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese;
Flessibilità, disponibilità a viaggiare.


To Make An Impact That Matters

Il network Deloitte, leader nei servizi professionali alle imprese, opera a livello globale in più di 150 Paesi con oltre 460 mila persone.

In Italia, Deloitte è presente in 24 città con circa 13.400 persone che assistono i clienti offrendo servizi di Audit & Assurance, Technology & Transformantion, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory e Tax & Legal.

In qualità di network globale ci impegniamo per affrontare le principali sfide sociali, economiche e ambientali della società di oggi. WorldImpact è il nostro programma globale che riunisce tutte le iniziative attraverso cui vogliamo avere un impatto positivo sulle persone, i clienti, l’ambiente e le comunità in cui operiamo.

Con Impact for Italy, la declinazione italiana di WorldImpact, Deloitte ha realizzato progetti che - in collaborazione con istituzioni, realtà del terzo settore, università e altri soggetti - hanno lasciato un impatto concreto e una legacy per il futuro su tutto il territorio nazionale.

La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006, il D.lgs. 215/03 e il D.lgs. 216/03 ed è aperta a candidat* di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.

Title: AI Scientist
Description:
Build the science that shapes the future of human health.

Application closing date: 11.11.2026

Join a place where ambitious science thrives

Human Technopole (Milan) is a rapidly expanding life science institute where international researchers and cutting-edge technologies converge to accelerate biomedical discovery. Our mission is to transform bold scientific ideas into advances that improve human health.

Within this mission, the Casale Group in the Health Data Science Centre develops AI methods that transform population-scale human data into mechanistic models of disease. Our research integrates large-scale human genetics with molecular and clinical data to generate testable hypotheses that accelerate biological discovery and therapeutic innovation.

We are recruiting an ambitious AI Scientist to build the reusable AI foundations and agentic scientific systems that power the group’s research across human genetics, multimodal biology, and disease.

Your mission

As AI Scientist, you will develop next-generation AI systems at the interface of ambitious biological research and frontier artificial intelligence, using population-scale genetics and multimodal biomedical data to uncover mechanisms of human disease.

You will turn methods and models emerging from this research into robust, reusable AI capabilities—including foundation models, multimodal representation learning, agentic workflows, evaluation frameworks, and scalable research software—that can accelerate discovery across multiple projects.

A longer-term goal is to develop AI systems that increasingly act as scientific collaborators: connecting evidence across biological scales, proposing testable hypotheses, identifying informative analyses, and working alongside researchers to accelerate iterative cycles of biological discovery.

Your work will combine methodological innovation, biological discovery, and scientific software development at the intersection of artificial intelligence, computational biology, and human genetics. You will have substantial scientific and technical ownership, with the opportunity to help shape the group’s technical AI architecture while leading and contributing to high-impact scientific publications, open-source software, and reusable research capabilities.

As part of Human Technopole’s interdisciplinary AI ecosystem, you will engage closely with the European AI community, including through collaborations with Helmholtz Munich and connections to the ELLIS network. Your work will benefit from interactions with computational, biological, and clinical groups across the institute, alongside opportunities for international collaboration, research exchanges, interdisciplinary training, and engagement with industry.

You will also draw on the group’s established network across leading academic institutions and industry partners in Europe and North America, helping you build collaborations, broaden your expertise, and accelerate the impact of your research.

Grow Your Skills

You will enhance your scientific and professional skills by:


Developing next-generation AI methods through ambitious biological research.
Building foundation models, multimodal representation learning approaches, and agentic AI systems for scientific discovery.
Turning scientific advances into robust, benchmarked, and reusable AI capabilities that accelerate discovery across multiple research projects.
Building scalable research software and AI workflows for large and heterogeneous scientific datasets.
Shaping the future of AI for science through high-impact publications, open-source software, international collaborations, and entrepreneurial initiatives.


Human Technopole supports career development through training, mentoring and dedicated learning opportunities.

Essential

What you'll bring


PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Computational Biology, or a related quantitative discipline, or expected completion within the next six months.
At least 4 years of relevant research experience by the start of the position, including doctoral research.
Strong track record of scientific output in AI, machine learning, computational biology, or biomedicine, demonstrating independent methodological or technical contributions through publications, open-source software, models, or comparable research outputs.
Excellent programming and software engineering skills in Python, with experience building scalable and maintainable research software, model-training workflows, or AI systems.
Strong expertise in modern machine learning and AI, with demonstrated ability to design, develop, and critically evaluate advanced methods for challenging research problems.
Experience with modern software engineering and computational research practices, including version control, testing, documentation, reproducibility, and large-scale GPU or HPC environments.


Preferred


Industry or applied R&D experience in roles such as AI/ML architect, research scientist, machine learning scientist, or equivalent positions with substantial technical ownership.
Experience developing foundation models or other large-scale AI systems for scientific or biomedical applications.
Experience developing or applying LLM-based agents and agentic workflows for scientific or technical tasks, including analysis, information integration, automation, or hypothesis generation.
Experience integrating multimodal biomedical datasets, including molecular, imaging, clinical, or population-scale data.
Experience leading collaborative software projects and contributing to open-source scientific software or models.
Experience with workflow management, containerisation, and scalable GPU/HPC computing.
Familiarity with human genetics and computational biology is advantageous but not required.
Experience applying AI within drug discovery, translational research, or related biomedical pipelines is an advantage.


Organizational and social skills


Strong analytical thinking and scientific curiosity.
Ability to work independently while thriving in an interdisciplinary and collaborative environment.
Excellent communication and scientific writing skills.
Creativity, intellectual humility, and enthusiasm for tackling challenging biological questions.
Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to take ownership of ambitious research projects.


At HT, your discoveries contribute to a global effort to improve human health.

Why Human Technopole

HT offers an international and dynamic workplace, competitive welfare provisions, flexible working policies and relocation support. Candidates moving to Italy may benefit from attractive tax benefits. We promote work–life balance and provide parental support initiatives.

Submit

How to apply


CV
Motivation letter (English)

Build the science that shapes the future of human health.

Application closing date: 11.11.2026

Join a place where ambitious science thrives

Human Technopole (Milan) is a rapidly expanding life science institute where international researchers and cutting-edge technologies converge to accelerate biomedical discovery. Our mission is to transform bold scientific ideas into advances that improve human health.

Within this mission, the Casale Group in the Health Data Science Centre develops AI methods that transform population-scale human data into mechanistic models of disease. Our research integrates large-scale human genetics with molecular and clinical data to generate testable hypotheses that accelerate biological discovery and therapeutic innovation.

We are recruiting an ambitious AI Scientist to build the reusable AI foundations and agentic scientific systems that power the group’s research across human genetics, multimodal biology, and disease.

Your mission

As AI Scientist, you will develop next-generation AI systems at the interface of ambitious biological research and frontier artificial intelligence, using population-scale genetics and multimodal biomedical data to uncover mechanisms of human disease.

You will turn methods and models emerging from this research into robust, reusable AI capabilities—including foundation models, multimodal representation learning, agentic workflows, evaluation frameworks, and scalable research software—that can accelerate discovery across multiple projects.

A longer-term goal is to develop AI systems that increasingly act as scientific collaborators: connecting evidence across biological scales, proposing testable hypotheses, identifying informative analyses, and working alongside researchers to accelerate iterative cycles of biological discovery.

Your work will combine methodological innovation, biological discovery, and scientific software development at the intersection of artificial intelligence, computational biology, and human genetics. You will have substantial scientific and technical ownership, with the opportunity to help shape the group’s technical AI architecture while leading and contributing to high-impact scientific publications, open-source software, and reusable research capabilities.

As part of Human Technopole’s interdisciplinary AI ecosystem, you will engage closely with the European AI community, including through collaborations with Helmholtz Munich and connections to the ELLIS network. Your work will benefit from interactions with computational, biological, and clinical groups across the institute, alongside opportunities for international collaboration, research exchanges, interdisciplinary training, and engagement with industry.

You will also draw on the group’s established network across leading academic institutions and industry partners in Europe and North America, helping you build collaborations, broaden your expertise, and accelerate the impact of your research.

Grow Your Skills

You will enhance your scientific and professional skills by:

  • Developing next-generation AI methods through ambitious biological research.
  • Building foundation models, multimodal representation learning approaches, and agentic AI systems for scientific discovery.
  • Turning scientific advances into robust, benchmarked, and reusable AI capabilities that accelerate discovery across multiple research projects.
  • Building scalable research software and AI workflows for large and heterogeneous scientific datasets.
  • Shaping the future of AI for science through high-impact publications, open-source software, international collaborations, and entrepreneurial initiatives.

Human Technopole supports career development through training, mentoring and dedicated learning opportunities.

Essential

What you'll bring

  • PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Computational Biology, or a related quantitative discipline, or expected completion within the next six months.
  • At least 4 years of relevant research experience by the start of the position, including doctoral research.
  • Strong track record of scientific output in AI, machine learning, computational biology, or biomedicine, demonstrating independent methodological or technical contributions through publications, open-source software, models, or comparable research outputs.
  • Excellent programming and software engineering skills in Python, with experience building scalable and maintainable research software, model-training workflows, or AI systems.
  • Strong expertise in modern machine learning and AI, with demonstrated ability to design, develop, and critically evaluate advanced methods for challenging research problems.
  • Experience with modern software engineering and computational research practices, including version control, testing, documentation, reproducibility, and large-scale GPU or HPC environments.

Preferred

  • Industry or applied R&D experience in roles such as AI/ML architect, research scientist, machine learning scientist, or equivalent positions with substantial technical ownership.
  • Experience developing foundation models or other large-scale AI systems for scientific or biomedical applications.
  • Experience developing or applying LLM-based agents and agentic workflows for scientific or technical tasks, including analysis, information integration, automation, or hypothesis generation.
  • Experience integrating multimodal biomedical datasets, including molecular, imaging, clinical, or population-scale data.
  • Experience leading collaborative software projects and contributing to open-source scientific software or models.
  • Experience with workflow management, containerisation, and scalable GPU/HPC computing.
  • Familiarity with human genetics and computational biology is advantageous but not required.
  • Experience applying AI within drug discovery, translational research, or related biomedical pipelines is an advantage.

Organizational and social skills

  • Strong analytical thinking and scientific curiosity.
  • Ability to work independently while thriving in an interdisciplinary and collaborative environment.
  • Excellent communication and scientific writing skills.
  • Creativity, intellectual humility, and enthusiasm for tackling challenging biological questions.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to take ownership of ambitious research projects.

At HT, your discoveries contribute to a global effort to improve human health.

Why Human Technopole

HT offers an international and dynamic workplace, competitive welfare provisions, flexible working policies and relocation support. Candidates moving to Italy may benefit from attractive tax benefits. We promote work–life balance and provide parental support initiatives.

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

We Are BCG X

We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Comfortable in a client-facing role with the ambition to lead teams
Likes to distill complex results or processes into simple, clear visualizations
Explain sophisticated data science concepts in an understandable manner
Love building things and are comfortable working with modern development tools and writing code collaboratively (bonus points if you have a software development or DevOps experience)
Significant experience applying advanced analytics to business situations and a proven ability to synthesize complex data
Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques and their mathematical underpinnings, and can translate this into business implications for our clients
Have strong project management skills
Fluency in both Italian and English

Requirements

Currently enrolled in a university master’s or PhD degree program in Computer Research Science, Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field

Technologies

Programming Languages: Python

La persona verrà inserita all’interno della Direzione “Rischi”, nell'area Risk Data & Solutions e si occuperà delle seguenti attività: (i) creazione, manutenzione ed evoluzione modelli di elaborazione dati per la a verifica della qualità dei dati stessi, secondo l’approccio di sviluppo ed integrazione continua; (ii) creazione e/o porting, manutenzione ed evoluzione di procedure di elaborazione dati orientate ai vari ambiti della Direzione Rischi (e.g. compliance, anti-riciclaggio, valutazione e monitoraggio del credito, etc.); (iii) creazione, manutenzione ed evoluzione reportistica analitica interattiva mediante utilizzo dello stack Office (e.g. PowerBI) o Python / Web (e.g. Streamlit / Dash / Flask); (iv) ottimizzazione dell’elaborazione e dell’utilizzo di risorse cloud (e.g. Azure Data Factory, Logic Apps, Container Instance, Batch Instance); (v) integrazione tecniche preddittive di Machine Learning con focus sulla minimizzazione della varianza ed ottimizzazione dell’allineamento dei risultati; (vi) redazione e manutenzione della documentazione per la gestione del patrimonio informativo ed applicativo. 

 


Requisiti
La persona ideale ha conseguito una laurea in Discipline Tecnico – Scientifiche come Fisica/Matematica/Statistica/Ingegneria – gradito dottorato o titolo post lauream. La persona ha maturato almeno 3 anni di esperienza come Data Engineer/Scientist all'interno di contesti strutturati, con un forte interesse per temi di finanza, risk management, compliance. Il ruolo richiede la conoscenza di Sql, PySpark, Python, Pandas, NumPy, Stack Azure (e.g. Synapse, ADF, LogicApps), Stack Office365 (Power Apps, PowerBI), Streamlit/Dash/Flask, Pipelines CI/CD, Git. Stack LLM (e.g. OpenRouter, Azure ML/AI). Si richiede inoltre un inglese fluente. Completano il profilo dinamismo, proattività, flessibilità, disponibilità e agilità di apprendimento, spiccate capacità di problem solving.

 

Sede: Milano

Deadline candidature: 6/10/2026

 

Posizionamento Economico

In conformità all'art. 5 del d.lgs. di attuazione della Direttiva (UE) 2023/970 in materia di trasparenza retributiva, si comunica che alla posizione è attribuita una retribuzione annua lorda iniziale compresa nella fascia tra € 40.000 e € 50.000, determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri sotto il profilo del genere. La posizione è inquadrata tra i livelli A3L3 - A3L4 del CCNL Credito applicato dal Gruppo CDP, le cui pertinenti disposizioni in materia di trattamento economico (in particolare gli artt. XIII relativi a inquadramento, minimi tabellari ed elementi retributivi fissi e continuativi) sono consultabili al seguente indirizzo: CCNL Credito e Bancari - Testo Completo 2026. La fascia indicata ha carattere orientativo e il posizionamento all'interno della stessa terrà conto dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del profilo professionale effettivamente accertati in sede di selezione. 

 

CDP promuove la diversità in tutte le sue forme e si impegna a creare un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo per tutte le nostre persone. Le candidature ricevute saranno considerate in base al merito individuale e all’aderenza alla posizione ricercata, indipendentemente da nazionalità, origine etnica, genere, orientamento sessuale, stato civile, disabilità, responsabilità genitoriali, età, religione o convinzioni personali.


Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91, a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei decreti legislativi 215/03 e 216/03 e a persone appartenenti alle categorie protette (L. 68/99).

Title: Advanced Analytics and AI Lead
Description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

The Talent Advanced Analytics Lead is responsible for shaping and delivering the organization's next-generation Talent Intelligence and Advanced Analytics strategy. This role combines executive leadership advisory, advanced analytics, AI innovation, talent intelligence, and data product delivery to enable leaders to make faster, more informed decisions to unlock value and drive business impact.

The role serves as a strategic advisor to global Talent, Function, Service Line, and Sector leaders by transforming talent, business, operational, and external market data into actionable intelligence. The individual will lead the development of scalable analytics products, AI-powered insights, and agentic solutions that enhance planning, skills intelligence, talent mobility, employee experience, productivity, and organizational effectiveness.

Essential Functions:

Talent Intelligence Strategy & Executive Advisory


Partner with Global Talent Leadership, Function Talent Leaders, Service Line Leaders, and Planning leaders to define and execute the Talent Intelligence strategy.
Act as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, translating complex workforce trends into strategic recommendations and actionable decisions.
Drive data-informed decision making across planning, skills transformation, workforce evolution, talent acquisition, retention, learning, talent mobility, and succession planning, etc
Deliver executive-ready narratives that combine quantitative insights with business context and future workforce implications.
Influence enterprise talent priorities through predictive and prescriptive analytics.


Advanced Analytics & AI Solutions


Lead the development of advanced analytics models to identify workforce risks, forecast talent demand, predict workforce trends, and uncover opportunities to improve organizational performance.
Design and deploy AI-powered talent intelligence solutions using machine learning, Generative AI, natural language processing, knowledge graphs, and predictive modelling techniques.
Establish scalable approaches for skills intelligence, workforce segmentation, talent forecasting, organizational network analysis, and workforce optimization.
Define methodologies that combine internal talent data with external labour market intelligence and economic indicators.
Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and analytics techniques to advance talent decision science capabilities.


Generative AI, Copilot & Agentic Solutions


Lead development of AI-enabled experiences using Data Bricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, enterprise GenAI platforms and machine learning, and intelligent automation capabilities.
Design and implement intelligent agents that automate talent insights generation, workforce analytics, executive insights, and decision support processes.
Build conversational analytics experiences that enable leaders to interact with talent data through natural language.
Establish governance, explainability, responsible AI, and adoption practices for AI-powered talent solutions.
Partner with technology teams to integrate agentic workflows into Talent operating models and business processes.
Drive experimentation and innovation through AI use cases that unlock measurable business value.


Data Products & Platform Leadership


Own the vision, roadmap, and lifecycle management of Talent analytics products and self-service insight solutions.
Lead development of enterprise Talent data products designed for broad organizational consumption.
Establish product management disciplines, user-centric design practices, and adoption strategies across Talent Intelligence initiatives.
Drive the transition from static reporting toward intelligent, scalable, reusable analytics products.
Identify opportunities to industrialize analytics capabilities and increase insight accessibility across stakeholder groups.
Enable scalable analytics architecture supporting structured and unstructured talent data.
Collaborate with Data Engineering and Technology teams to optimize data quality, governance, lineage, accessibility, and security.
Drive modernization of the talent analytics ecosystem through cloud-native analytics capabilities.


Insights, Storytelling & Executive Communications


Transform analytical outputs into compelling executive narratives and strategic workforce recommendations.
Create executive dashboards and insight products that simplify complex workforce information.
Develop thought leadership that shapes future Talent Intelligence capabilities and workforce decision-making practices.
Present findings confidently to executive talent leaders and senior business stakeholders.
Drive adoption of analytics by making insights easily understandable, relevant, and actionable.


Leadership & Capability Development


Lead and develop a high-performing team of data scientists, workforce strategists, analytics consultants, AI practitioners, and product managers.
Establish talent intelligence standards, methodologies, and governance frameworks.
Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, continuous learning, and responsible AI usage.
Build organizational capabilities in analytics, AI literacy, data storytelling, and product thinking.
Manage delivery across global, offshore, vendor, and managed-service teams where applicable.


Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:


Determine strategic priorities for Talent Intelligence and Advanced Analytics programs.
Prioritize investments and resource allocation across analytics, AI, and data product portfolios.
Define and monitor key workforce intelligence metrics and success measures.
Evaluate emerging workforce trends, technologies, and market developments to influence strategic direction.
Balance innovation investments with operational scalability, governance, and business value realization.
Ensure responsible and ethical use of workforce data and AI solutions.


Knowledge and Skills Requirements:

Strategic & Business Skills


Deep understanding of Talent Intelligence, Planning, Talent Analytics, Workforce Evolution and Talent Strategy.
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and executive influence capabilities.
Ability to align talent analytics outcomes with broader business objectives.
Strong commercial acumen and understanding of organizational transformation.


Analytics & Data Science Skills


Advanced statistical analysis and predictive modelling, Machine Learning and AI solution design, Experimental design and causal inference methodologies, Skills intelligence and talent marketplace analytics, Expertise in data storytelling and executive reporting.


AI & Emerging Technology Skills


Generative AI solutions design and implementation, Microsoft Copilot ecosystem expertise, Copilot Studio and conversational AI development, Agentic AI architecture and orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns, Prompt engineering and AI governance, Responsible AI and model explainability, Knowledge management and semantic search solutions.


Data & Technology Skills


Data Bricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and advanced visualization.
SQL and advanced data modelling.
Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, Enterprise GenAI platforms and Machine Learning
Python and R, Modern cloud analytics architectures.
API and data integration concepts, Data governance and metadata management.


Leadership Competencies


Executive presence, Strategic thinking, Innovation mindset, Change leadership.
Product-centric thinking, Collaboration across global teams, Enterprise influence and stakeholder engagement.
Ability to cope with ambiguity; to drive change and performance outcomes in a complex and agile environment.


Supervision Responsibilities:


Work closely with the Leads across Global Talent and wider Talent Functions to ensure the provision of services that support business and functional delivery.
Lead / manage a team of expert data analytics specialists responsible for functional execution, also build skills and capabilities of the team.
Develop AI capabilities, define key AI competencies for the team, and ensure provision of learning to advance skills
Independently maintain and leverage (when appropriate) an internal network, including effective partnerships with senior stakeholders, across EY practices / functions that will enable personal effectiveness in the position.

Solida conoscenza di Python per il Machine Learning e la Data Science.

Esperienza in deployment di modelli AI su infrastrutture containerizzate (Docker, Kubernetes).

Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science o discipline affini.
Analitico, curioso, agile, paziente e orientato alla qualità

Title: Risk Analytics Junior Consultant | Milan 1
Description:
Risk Analytics Junior Consultant | Milan

The chance to build a better future is right in front of you

Responsibilities

Do Work That Matters - Your role and responsibilities

Do you want to pursue a profession that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, the company and colleagues address and solve the most current and complex challenges. KPMG Advisory offers consulting services to companies to assist them in business model transformation, process improvement and digitisation, risk analysis and management, and support in extraordinary finance transac tions. When you join the Risk Analytics team in Milan, you are going to work on financial projects using tech solutions and AI support for top-tier clients in different sectors.

Specifically, you will be tasked with:


Risk Analysis & Application Development :


Build and maintain high-performance applications and microservices that underpin data analytics platforms; develop robust APIs and integration layers to seamlessly connect various internal and external data sources.


Financial Data Engineering & Control:


Design, implement, and optimize financial data ingestion and transformation pipelines to process high-volume datasets from diverse energy systems and sensors; ensure data quality and integrity through testing, validation and monitoring processes.


Financial Analytics, Reporting & Visualization:


Collaborate with data scientists to integrate machine learning algorithms and predictive modeling into live production environments; create interactive dashboards and reporting tools that transform raw data into actionable insights for technical and non-technical stakeholders.


System Optimization & Scalability:


Enhance system performance through code optimization, cost optimization, robust testing, and effective resource management; implement scalable solutions that support growing data demands and evolving business needs in the client domain.


Agile Collaboration:


Participate in agile development practices, including sprint planning, code reviews, and continuous integration, to ensure efficient delivery of features and improvements; work closely with cross-disciplinary teams, including business analysts, data engineers, and product managers, to align technological advancements with strategic objectives.

Skills

Come As You Are - Your skills and characteristics

This is the perfect opportunity if you have:


Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field;
Motivation to build a career in the Risk sector with a focus on financial services industry;
Some knowledge in software engineering with a strong understanding of full-stack development;
Proficiency in modern programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Javascript or similar) and experience working with data processing frameworks;
Some knowledge with API development, cloud platforms, and containerization technologies;
Familiarity with data visualization tools and basic statistical modeling techniques;
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.


Your Future With Us - What you’ll find at KPMG


Immediate exposure to live data challenges, where you can apply your skills to solve authentic business problems and see the impact of your work in real time.
Join a collaborative, agile team that values creativity, technical excellence, and practical problem solving, facilitating rapid prototyping and successful project deployments (from PoCs to MVPs).
Opportunities to acquire leading certifications (Azure, Google Cloud, AWS, Databricks) and engag e in challenging projects that accelerate your technical and professional learning curve.
Tailored compensation packages and benefits designed to support both your personal and professional success.


Standard employment contract under the collective labour agreement for the commerce sector, with a starting gross annual salary of €29,000. The salary is determined on the basis of objective criteria, including educational qualifications and an assessment of the candidate’s profile against the requirements of the role.

In accordance with applicable legislation, we do not collect or use information relating to remuneration received in current or previous employment. Our selection procedures are based on objective and gender-neutral criteria.

Together for Better – Our values and commitment

Leadership, teamwork, respect every individual, continuous learning, transparency, commitment to the community and integrity. These are the KPMG values that create an environment that encourages the sharing of ideas and knowledge, so our professionals can achieve their full potential.

As a result of our commitment to fostering an inclusive work environment, our Network complies with the standards of the ISO 30415 requirements, on the Diversity and Inclusion Management System, and UNI PdR 125, relating to gender equality”. Within our Impact Plan - Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) - you will find summarised all the actions we are taking on environmental, social and governance (ESG) issues.

Join us!

Title: Lead AI Validation & Governance (GenAI & ML)
Description:
Within the Group Data, Artificial Intelligence and Automation department, we are looking for a highly experienced Data Scientist / Data Engineer to lead AI Validation and Governance across both traditional Machine Learning and next-generation Generative and Agentic AI systems.




The Lead AI Validation & Governance (GenAI & ML) will play a pivotal role in defining, implementing, and scaling the Group’s AI governance and model risk framework, ensuring that AI systems are robust, explainable, compliant, and fit for purpose in business-critical contexts.

This role sits at the intersection of AI model validation, model risk management, and Responsible AI, providing independent oversight and technical leadership across the entire AI lifecycle — from design and development to deployment, monitoring, and periodic review.

In addition to its strategic and governance responsibilities, this role is expected to remain strongly hands-on, actively contributing to the design, validation, and testing of AI models and systems.




The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with a pragmatic mindset, and is comfortable developing and reviewing model validation code; working directly with ML and GenAI pipelines; building prototypes, validation tools, and monitoring solutions; interacting with data, models, and APIs in a production-oriented environment




Key responsibilities of the role will include:

Perform independent validation and challenge of AI/ML and agentic/Generative AI systems across the full lifecycle, including model design, data quality, and performance (accuracy, robustness, explainability, fairness)
Align validation and governance practices with applicable regulations (e.g., EU AI Act), internal guidelines, and risk appetite, translating requirements into operational processes and controls
Identify and assess key risks (bias, explainability, compliance), and define appropriate validation controls and mitigation actions
Define and implement continuous monitoring and alerting mechanisms for AI systems in production (e.g., data/performance drift, emerging risks such as GenAI hallucinations)
Ensure ongoing compliance through lifecycle oversight, including periodic re-validation of models
Design and implement reusable functionalities to enable scalable governance and monitoring of AI models and agents
Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders, acting as asecond line of defense to challenge assumptions and strengthen decision-making
Maintain robust documentation and support audit and regulatory reviews, while contributing to standards, templates, and best practices




Requirements

Strong expertise in machine learning, Generative AI and agentic AI, with solid knowledge of AI lifecycle frameworks and validation/governance practices
4-7+ years of experience in AI/ML validation, model risk, or AI governance preferably within structured or regulated environments
Advanced Python programming skills (object-oriented design) with hands-on experience in core data science libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, LightGBM)
Proven ability to develop clean, modular, maintainable code, with strong focus on robustness, reproducibility, and quality
High autonomy and proactivity, with strong collaboration skills and good understanding of regulatory frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act), explainability tools, and modern AI architectures
Italian and English working proficiency




Soft skills:

Analytical thinking, risk mindset, communication skills, ability to challenge assumptions, strong documentation discipline
Ability to work independently and as part of a team, collaborating with individuals with diverse mindsets
Proficiency in multitasking and managing dynamic deadlines
Willingness to learn new technological and complex topics and to continuously challenge oneself




What we offer

We offer employment at the VI level with the relevant salary, in accordance with the CCNL ANIA for non-executive employees and the Generali Group Company Agreement.




Gross annual salary ranging between 43K€ and 55K€. The final offer will be aligned with the candidate’s professional experience, technical and soft skills relevant to the role, and may include an individual variable component.




We also offer:

Smart working and flexible hours
Corporate welfare system
Meal vouchers
Supplementary health insurance and discounted insurance policies
Wellbeing initiatives
Training and development
Structured continuous learning paths (technical and managerial)
Career development programs within the Group
Access to learning platforms and internal mobility opportunities, including international

We offer career development paths, continuous learning opportunities, and internal mobility, rewarding talent and merit. We believe in flexibility as a key driver of employee wellbeing and a sustainable work-life balance.

We’re growing fast, backed by top-tier investors and a world-class team committed to rigor, clarity, and impact.

Today, Lexroom is a trusted partner, shaping the evolution of legal AI with the same rigor and precision that define our product.

Why Lexroom.ai?


Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.
Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional minds driven by competence, curiosity, and ambition.
Deliver Meaningful Results: Your contribution will empower legal professionals to make faster, clearer, and more reliable decisions worldwide.


At Lexroom.ai, we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts: a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world.

What You'll Do


Design and build agent-driven and RAG-based AI systems to solve complex legal tasks with precision and efficiency.
Fine-tune and post-train LLMs using cutting-edge supervised and reinforcement learning techniques to raise response quality.
Develop and optimize large-scale search pipelines for LLM-powered agents.
Implement and refine NLP algorithms to extract, structure, and validate information from legal documents.
Run end-to-end evaluations to pinpoint bottlenecks, measure performance, and guide continuous improvements.
Work closely with legal experts to design evaluation protocols and build reliable, domain-specific datasets that strengthen every layer of the stack.
Maintain technical excellence by following established best practices, coding standards, and rigorous code-review processes.


What You’ll Bring


Proven expertise in building and managing robust ML pipelines.
Strong Python skills with hands-on experience in LLM research and deep learning systems.
Knowledge of search technologies such as full-text search, vector databases, or other large-scale retrieval systems.
Collaborative mindset and readiness to work with legal experts, researchers, and engineers to keep improving the product.
Familiarity with MLOps and integrating ML models into production backends (a strong plus).
Up-to-date with LLM innovation, ideally with experience in pre-training or deploying large-scale models in real-world scenarios.


What Sets Us Apart

An Exceptional Team.

At Lexroom.ai, you’ll work alongside top talent in tech and legal AI.

Our focused teams operate with purpose and autonomy, so every contribution delivers visible results.

You’ll collaborate with people who pair innovation with rigor, curiosity with discipline, ambition with depth.

Growth that Matters.

We hire exceptional people to make a difference—and we give them space to lead.

As we scale, your work will shape the future of legal technology and set new standards for the field.

Impact is defined by vision and execution, not by age or title. If you’re ready to take responsibility, you’ll find real opportunities to grow and lead high-stakes projects.

Rewarding Your Contribution.

We value excellence and share success:


Annual Salary Range: €45,000 – €100,000
Equity Package: Align your growth with the company’s long-term success.


Benefits That Matter


Hybrid Work: Flexibility to balance remote work with in-person collaboration at our Milan HQ.
Health Coverage: Comprehensive insurance to keep you secure and focused.
Meal Vouchers: Daily support for your lunch breaks.

Title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Credit modelling
Description:
Klarna, briefly

At Klarna, we're building an everyday finance network, helping over 120 million consumers across 26 countries save time and money, and worry less about their finances. Working here means taking on problems most companies never get to solve, and being hands-on enough that the interesting part of the work lands with you, not someone else — you'll build with AI, not watch it happen.

This is the stretch zone. Come find out what you're capable of.

About The Role

Every credit decision Klarna makes runs through a model, and every one of those models runs through a pipeline your team builds and operates. As a Lead Engineer on the Credit Modeling Pipeline team, you'll be the engineer who takes consumer credit underwriting models from a data scientist's experiment to something running reliably in production.

This is an engineering position, not a data science one with some engineering on the side. Most of your time goes into writing production code, building the infrastructure the ML pipeline depends on, and deploying models with tools like AWS SageMaker — not developing new modeling approaches from scratch.

You'll work alongside a team split between Stockholm and Warsaw, and help scale Klarna's in-house data science capability as the credit risk and fraud teams grow.

What You'll Do


You'll write Python to train credit underwriting models, including tree-based models, and prepare them to run in production.
You'll build and maintain the infrastructure that supports the ML pipeline — from feature computation through to retraining and monitoring.
You'll deploy models into production using tools such as AWS SageMaker, and keep them running once they're live.
You'll troubleshoot and fix pipeline issues end to end, rather than handing them off to someone else.
You'll help scale Klarna's in-house data science capability as the credit risk and fraud teams grow.


Who You Are


You've written production Python for machine learning — training models, not just prototyping them in notebooks.
You've taken machine learning models and pipelines from development into production, and owned them once they were live.
You've worked with tree-based models hands-on, not just studied them in theory.
You've deployed and operated ML workloads on AWS or a comparable cloud platform.
You understand the full software development lifecycle — version control, testing, and code review — and apply it to ML code, not just one-off scripts.
You've worked closely with data scientists, turning their models into pipelines they can rely on in production.
You communicate clearly in English, spoken and written.


Bonus points for


You've worked in credit risk, fraud, or another part of financial services, and know the regulatory weight that comes with lending decisions.
You've built data pipelines at scale inside a larger data science or engineering organization.
You're familiar with model monitoring or observability tools — drift detection, performance dashboards, and the like.
You've set up CI/CD for ML deployment.


Things you should know before applying


This position is based in Stockholm or Milan; you'll work alongside a team split between Stockholm and Warsaw.
Working together: we value co-located teams; most teams currently meet in the office 2–3 days per week, and this varies by team and can change over time.
Non-obvious backgrounds are welcome. Diversity of skills, perspectives and backgrounds is how we create, innovate, and disrupt like no other.
Final compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.


Please include a CV in English. Concrete beats comprehensive — what you built, what it did, what it cost.

Curious to learn more about Klarna and what it's like to work here? Explore our career site!

  • You'll help scale Klarna's in-house data science capability as the credit risk and fraud teams grow.

  • You've written production Python for machine learning — training models, not just prototyping them in notebooks.
  • You've taken machine learning models and pipelines from development into production, and owned them once they were live.
  • You've worked with tree-based models hands-on, not just studied them in theory.
  • You've deployed and operated ML workloads on AWS or a comparable cloud platform.
  • You understand the full software development lifecycle — version control, testing, and code review — and apply it to ML code, not just one-off scripts.
  • You've worked closely with data scientists, turning their models into pipelines they can rely on in production.
  • You communicate clearly in English, spoken and written.

  • You've worked in credit risk, fraud, or another part of financial services, and know the regulatory weight that comes with lending decisions.
  • You've built data pipelines at scale inside a larger data science or engineering organization.
  • You're familiar with model monitoring or observability tools — drift detection, performance dashboards, and the like.
  • You've set up CI/CD for ML deployment.

Things you should know before applying

  • This position is based in Stockholm or Milan; you'll work alongside a team split between Stockholm and Warsaw.
  • Working together: we value co-located teams; most teams currently meet in the office 2–3 days per week, and this varies by team and can change over time.
  • Non-obvious backgrounds are welcome. Diversity of skills, perspectives and backgrounds is how we create, innovate, and disrupt like no other.
  • Final compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.

Please include a CV in English. Concrete beats comprehensive — what you built, what it did, what it cost.

Chi cerchiamo?

Costruire e mantenere dataset e modelli dati a supporto delle attività di growth, sfruttando le piattaforme e l'infrastruttura dati aziendali già disponibili
Integrare e armonizzare i dati provenienti da fonti diverse (CRO, Media, CRM, web analytics) in una visione unificata
Garantire la qualità, la coerenza e l'affidabilità dei dati utilizzati per le analisi
Implementare e presidiare le logiche di misurazione (tracciamenti, eventi, conversioni)

Utilizzare strumenti di AI generativa per accelerare l'analisi dei dati e la produzione di report

Solide competenze tecniche nella modellazione e trasformazione dei dati (SQL, data modeling)
Esperienza concreta nell'integrazione di dati da fonti CRO, Media e CRM
Padronanza di strumenti di analytics e data visualization (es. Google Analytics 4, Looker, Power BI, Tableau)
Ottima capacità di tradurre dati complessi in insight e narrazioni comprensibili per il business
Autonomia operativa, capacità di prioritizzazione e gestione di più attività in parallelo
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese
Conoscenza di linguaggi di scripting per la manipolazione dei dati (es. Python)
Familiarità con strumenti di AI generativa applicati all'analisi
Esperienza con ambienti di data warehousing (es. BigQuery, Snowflake)
Background in contesti growth-oriented o di performance marketing




La retribuzione annua lorda (RAL) prevista per il ruolo è compresa tra € 40.000 ed €54.000, in base all’esperienza e al livello di seniority.




In ENGIE, ogni talento ha un ruolo fondamentale nell’accelerare la transizione energetica. Contribuisci a fare la differenza e vivi un’esperienza professionale ricca di soddisfazioni. Affronta sfide stimolanti e costruisci un percorso di carriera che rispecchi davvero chi sei.

Unisciti a noi e partecipa all’avventura del secolo!

Scommettiamo sul potere della collettività e agiamo come parte di una comunità impegnata a sconvolgere e reinventare il futuro. Diversità e inclusione sono al centro della nostra cultura aziendale. ENGIE si impegna a combattere tutte le forme di discriminazione in materia di occupazione, accesso alla formazione e promozione. Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
About The Company

Scrambly is one of the fastest-growing adtech startups in the world, featured in the AppsFlyer Performance Index and Singular ROI Index in just 3.5 years.

We’re growing 250%+ YoY across revenue, team, product, and technology — fully bootstrapped and profitable.

We’re building the future of app discovery: a reward-powered alternative to the App Store and Google Play. Our loyalty-driven ecosystem connects millions of users with the world’s top apps and delivers unmatched, ROI-focused growth for mobile advertisers.

Our mission is to build a true alternative to traditional app stores — fueled by rewards and data — and create a new, performance-first growth engine for mobile app advertisers.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to own the models behind how Scrambly spends and makes money — what our users are worth, what we should pay to acquire and reward them, and how we keep the ecosystem free of abuse.

The centre of the role is predicting user and cohort value — forecasting what people will be worth from early signal, and keeping those forecasts accurate as the product and the market move underneath them. Around it sits a set of connected problems across marketing, monetisation, and risk, each of which turns a prediction into a decision the business acts on. We will go through the specifics with you during the process.

You will own the modelling end to end: framing the problem, building the model, deciding how it is evaluated, and staying with it once it is live. You will not be doing that alone — you will work closely with our engineers on data, pipelines, serving, and integration.

This is an early hire on a data team being built from scratch, reporting to and working day to day with the Head of Data. We are flexible on level. The title reflects the ownership and independence the role carries, not a hard experience bar — we will set the level, title, and compensation to match what you bring.

Key Responsibilities


Value prediction. Own and improve how we forecast user and cohort value from early behaviour, across our different revenue streams. Improve accuracy where it matters most commercially, and keep the models working as the product changes.
Bidding and pricing. Build the modelling that decides what we are willing to pay to acquire users, together with the controls that keep spend inside margin limits while the system is still learning.
Segmentation and targeting. Build the scoring and segmentation that lets us treat users, partners, and inventory according to the value they actually deliver.
Fraud and abuse. Improve the accuracy of our fraud models, and balance catching abuse against wrongly penalising real users.
Evaluation. Decide how each model is judged and hold that line — out-of-sample discipline, backtesting, and choosing metrics that reflect the commercial objective rather than the convenient one. Stay close to your models once they are live, and flag when accuracy starts to slip.
Collaboration. Work with the Head of Data on prioritisation, with our engineers on data pipelines and serving, and with commercial teams on turning model output into decisions they trust.


Requirements


4+ years as a data scientist working on production models that drive real decisions. We care more about what you have owned than about the number.
Hands-on experience with LTV or ROAS prediction — forecasting user or cohort value from early behaviour, and dealing with the problems that come with it: immature cohorts, long horizons, sparse segments, and models that decay as the product changes. This is the core of the role and we are looking for someone who has done it before.
Adtech or mobile performance marketing background — attribution and MMP data, cohort and campaign economics, and how UA spend actually gets decided. Backgrounds in gaming, gambling, or user-incentive and loyalty systems are equally relevant, and experience with rewarded, offerwall, or incentivised apps is a significant advantage.
Strong Python and SQL, with production experience on a cloud data warehouse — BigQuery preferred.
Rigour about evaluation: you choose the metric that matches the business objective, you are careful about out-of-sample and point-in-time correctness, and you are willing to say a model is not good enough to ship.
Experience of models that made it into production and were used to make real decisions — you understand what it takes to get there and what happens to a model afterwards.
Commercial judgement and clear communication — able to explain a model to people who will spend money based on it, and to push back when the data does not support the question being asked.
A proactive, self-directed way of working. You will be in a very small team, with a lot of latitude and little process.
English at B2+, written and spoken — you will document your work and work daily with an international team.


Nice to Have


Bidding, pricing, or budget allocation systems — control loops, bandits, or other approaches to spending under uncertainty.
Fraud, anomaly detection, or trust & safety modelling, especially with weak or incomplete labels.
Experimentation and causal inference — A/B design, power analysis, and incrementality measurement.
Survival, hierarchical, or Bayesian methods applied to retention, monetisation, or sparse-segment problems.
BQML, Dataform, or dbt, or other experience building models close to the warehouse.
Deploying and monitoring models yourself — pipelines, serving, retraining, and drift monitoring.


What We Offer


Ownership of the models that set UA spend, offer payouts, and fraud decisions — work directly attached to revenue, with visible impact within weeks.
Problems with real depth: long-horizon forecasting, adaptivity, pricing under uncertainty, and fraud with imperfect ground truth.
A close working relationship with the Head of Data, a real say in how the data function is built, and room to grow as the team expands.
A level and compensation matched to what you bring, rather than to the title on the advert.
A profitable, bootstrapped company growing 250%+ YoY, where investment in data is justified by results rather than budget cycles.


By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Job description




Let's build the future of AI & Data, together 🧙




At Data Wizards, we're focused on 3 things: Data, AI & you.




We're a small team who genuinely love digging into data that makes a real difference for the companies we work with, and who want to discover how AI and data can help companies out there.




Why join us? Apart from tackling exciting challenges with passionate people in an environment that wants to see you thrive, you'll be part of a young company that keeps its feet on the ground, its eyes on the stars, and believes the best growth comes from the unique magic each Wizard brings.




We are continuously on the lookout for bright data engineers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, AI engineers, and data analysts. But this job description is for Senior Data Scientists out there feeling the magic in them and ready to spread it 🪄




We are currently looking for a senior data scientist for a fraud detection project where you would do:




Strengthening our fraud models by improving how we collect, label, structure and engineer features from complex transactional and behavioral data
Designing, building and continuously refining fraud detection models using machine learning, graph analytics, anomaly detection and behavioral analytics
Turning large volumes of transactional and customer data into actionable fraud intelligence through feature engineering, data enrichment and pattern discovery
Partnering with Fraud Operations, Risk, Compliance and Product teams to spot emerging fraud trends and translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions
Digging into complex fraud schemes, uncovering new attack vectors and building proactive detection strategies that protect the business financially and reputationally
But being a consulting company, we can't know in advance what your exact responsibilities will be




Job requirements




You’re a step closer to joining our team if you bring:




Background




At least 5 years of experience in data science, with a solid grounding in fraud detection, ideally within the financial sector
A Master's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, computer science or engineering. A PhD is a plus, and candidates with a different academic background but strong analytical skills are equally welcome




Technical Skills




Hands-on experience processing large-scale, complex transactional and behavioral datasets using SQL, Python (Pandas) and distributed processing frameworks such as Spark or Hadoop
Proven ability to apply supervised and unsupervised machine learning, anomaly detection, graph analytics and network analysis to detect, investigate and prevent fraud. Experience with generative AI is a plus
Strong Python skills, with experience deploying AI applications into production; familiarity with Java is a plus




Soft Skills




Autonomous & Proactive: You take initiative and drive projects forward.
Curious & Adaptive: You embrace learning and thrive in dynamic environments.
Solution-Oriented: You balance technical rigor with business impact.
Clear Communicator: You simplify complex ideas for diverse audiences.
Collaborative & Supportive: You work well in teams.
Creative Thinker: You find innovative solutions to challenging problems.
Languages: Fluent in English, French and/or Dutch.




We know that finding the right job isn’t just about the role, it’s about what’s in it for you, too. While we’re a start-up, we’re big on taking care of our people right from day one.




Here's a sneak peek at what we offer:




💰 A compensation package that keeps you motivated




Competitive salary
Mobility budget or company car with an electrical card
30 days of paid time off
A top-tier laptop & smartphone with a subscription
Representation allowances
Group, hospitalization & dental insurance
Meal vouchers & eco-cheques
Opportunity to earn company stock over time




🌱 A place to be your best self, grow, and thrive




Work with the most innovative technologies in Data & AI
Work in an agile, collaborative environment
Hybrid work model: up to 3 days per week
Monthly team-building events (plus one epic annual celebration)
Tailored training programs to fuel your career growth
A cool, ergonomic office with creative meeting spaces, a Nintendo Switch for spontaneous Mario Kart battles, a massage chair for those deep-thinking moments and fresh coffee & drinks to keep you energized ☕




✨ And most importantly, an organic-growing company where you are in control of your own path!




Our Recruitment Process:




📲Quick intro call with our HR team (5')

💜Culture check: HR Interview (30')

🛠️Technical check: Wizard assessment (25') & Technical Interview with our wizards (1h)

🤝Partner Meet-up (30')




Why this process?

We want you to get a genuine feel for who we are, and we want to make sure we're aligned on what truly matters. Rather than rushing the process, we focus on finding the right fit, so that six months from now, both sides are still convinced they made the right decision.




➡️If you're passionate about what we do but aren't sure you meet every single requirement, don't hesitate to apply. We value potential, mindset, and growth as much as experience. At Data Wizards, we believe diversity is our strength. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences because different viewpoints help us grow and evolve.




➡️Please note: As a consulting company, our recruitment process can be either project-driven or based on strong profiles we believe in. The consultancy world moves fast, and while we always aim to match great talent with the right opportunity, there might not always be an immediate fit. With your permission, we'll gladly keep your profile in mind for future missions, and hope to collaborate with you soon on an exciting project at Data Wizards!

  • But being a consulting company, we can't know in advance what your exact responsibilities will be

You’re a step closer to joining our team if you bring:


Background

  • A Master's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, computer science or engineering. A PhD is a plus, and candidates with a different academic background but strong analytical skills are equally welcome


Technical Skills


  • Hands-on experience processing large-scale, complex transactional and behavioral datasets using SQL, Python (Pandas) and distributed processing frameworks such as Spark or Hadoop
  • Proven ability to apply supervised and unsupervised machine learning, anomaly detection, graph analytics and network analysis to detect, investigate and prevent fraud. Experience with generative AI is a plus
  • Strong Python skills, with experience deploying AI applications into production; familiarity with Java is a plus


Soft Skills


  • Autonomous & Proactive: You take initiative and drive projects forward.
  • Curious & Adaptive: You embrace learning and thrive in dynamic environments.
  • Solution-Oriented: You balance technical rigor with business impact.
  • Clear Communicator: You simplify complex ideas for diverse audiences.
  • Collaborative & Supportive: You work well in teams.
  • Creative Thinker: You find innovative solutions to challenging problems.
  • Languages: Fluent in English, French and/or Dutch.


We know that finding the right job isn’t just about the role, it’s about what’s in it for you, too. While we’re a start-up, we’re big on taking care of our people right from day one.


Here's a sneak peek at what we offer:


💰 A compensation package that keeps you motivated


  • Competitive salary
  • Mobility budget or company car with an electrical card
  • 30 days of paid time off
  • A top-tier laptop & smartphone with a subscription
  • Representation allowances
  • Group, hospitalization & dental insurance
  • Meal vouchers & eco-cheques
  • Opportunity to earn company stock over time


🌱 A place to be your best self, grow, and thrive


  • Work with the most innovative technologies in Data & AI
  • Work in an agile, collaborative environment
  • Hybrid work model: up to 3 days per week
  • Monthly team-building events (plus one epic annual celebration)
  • Tailored training programs to fuel your career growth
  • A cool, ergonomic office with creative meeting spaces, a Nintendo Switch for spontaneous Mario Kart battles, a massage chair for those deep-thinking moments and fresh coffee & drinks to keep you energized ☕

📲Quick intro call with our HR team (5')

We want you to get a genuine feel for who we are, and we want to make sure we're aligned on what truly matters. Rather than rushing the process, we focus on finding the right fit, so that six months from now, both sides are still convinced they made the right decision.


➡️If you're passionate about what we do but aren't sure you meet every single requirement, don't hesitate to apply. We value potential, mindset, and growth as much as experience. At Data Wizards, we believe diversity is our strength. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences because different viewpoints help us grow and evolve.

Around 20% of our sales volumes are from new and patent protected products.

At our innovation centres of excellence in the UK, Germany, China, Malaysia and Ohio, USA we collaborate closely with our customers to develop new products and enhance existing ones tailored to their needs, with an increasing range of sustainability benefits. Since 2021, we have been proud holders of the London Stock Exchange Green Economy Mark, which recognises green technology businesses making a significant contribution to a more sustainable, low-carbon economy.

Data Scientist

Turn data into business value

Location: Home-based (Netherlands, Belgium or United Kingdom)

Type: Full-time

At Synthomer, we're investing in data, analytics, and artificial intelligence to transform how we operate and make decisions. To support this ambition, we are expanding our new Digital Centre of Excellence and are looking for a talented Data Scientist to help drive innovation across the business.

If you're passionate about solving complex problems, building predictive models, and creating tangible business impact through data, we'd love to hear from you.

Your impact

As a Data Scientist, you'll transform data into actionable insights, develop advanced analytical solutions, and help shape the next generation of digital capabilities at Synthomer. You'll work alongside Data Engineers, Data Translators, and business stakeholders to develop end-to-end solutions that create measurable value.

What You'll Be Doing


Explore, prepare, and refine datasets for advanced analytics and machine learning.
Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.
Develop predictive and prescriptive models using statistical and machine learning techniques.
Design feature engineering strategies to maximize model performance.
Communicate insights through visualizations, presentations, and dashboards.
Deploy machine learning models and monitor performance in production environments.
Support and promote the use of AI, advanced analytics, and data-driven decision-making across the organization.


What We're Looking For


2-5 years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, or Machine Learning.
Strong knowledge of statistics, predictive modelling, and machine learning techniques.
Proficiency in Python, SQL, Databricks, and Apache Spark.
Experience working with cloud-based analytics platforms.
Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex insights to business stakeholders.
A curious mindset and passion for innovation and continuous learning.


Why join Synthomer?


Play a key role in building a world-class Digital Centre of Excellence.
Work on high-impact AI and advanced analytics projects.
Collaborate with global teams across manufacturing, commercial, operational, and corporate functions.
Enjoy the flexibility of a home-based role.
Help shape the future of digital innovation in a leading global specialty chemicals business.
