Travailler à la MC, c’est travailler avec enthousiasme.

Parce qu’à la MC, vous avez un impact positif sur la vie de millions de Belges. C’est ce que vivent chaque jour nos milliers de collaborateurs. Nous contribuons ensemble à une société plus saine pour tous. Cela donne de la satisfaction et de l’énergie.

Pour vous aussi, la MC est un environnement de travail agréable et bienveillant, où vous échangez des idées et où vous vous développez. Où l’on peut compter sur ses collègues et où l’on est en relation les uns avec les autres. Éprouver du plaisir dans notre travail, c’est notre raison d’être !

À la MC, chaque jour compte. Pour les gens, pour la société et pour soi-même.

Avec 650 collègues ICT, nous travaillons ensemble chaque jour pour fournir le meilleur service à nos 4,7 millions de membres et à nos près de 8.000 membres du personnel.

Flexibilité garantie ! Possibilité de travailler à domicile 4 jours par semaine ou depuis l’un de nos bureaux régionaux.

Description de fonction

L'équipe Data Analytics soutient la MC dans son ambition de devenir la mutualité la plus orientée données de Belgique. Nous accompagnons l'organisation tout au long de son parcours data et analytique et développons des solutions sur mesure basées sur des technologies modernes. Nous aidons ainsi les différents domaines métier à exploiter pleinement leurs données afin de stimuler l'innovation, optimiser les processus et atteindre leurs objectifs stratégiques.

Notre expertise couvre notamment la stratégie de données, la gouvernance des données, l'analytique avancée, l'animation d'ateliers d'innovation ainsi que le développement de solutions data sur mesure.

Vous rejoignez une équipe multiculturelle composée d'environ 30 professionnels, parmi lesquels des Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Reporting Specialists et Analystes. Ensemble, nous concevons des solutions innovantes au service des différents domaines métier de la MC.

Aujourd'hui, l'équipe est au cœur d'une transformation majeure. Nous évoluons d'un modèle de services centralisé vers des équipes Agile orientées domaine, où les métiers et l'IT partagent la responsabilité des solutions de données qu'ils développent et gèrent.

En tant que Data Scientist, vous analysez des problématiques complexes et développez des différents types de produits data tels que des modèles prédictifs des dashboards ou des API qui contribuent aux décisions stratégiques. Vous réalisez des analyses approfondies, expérimentez avec des algorithmes et transformez les insights en solutions concrètes à impact sociétal.

Vous collaborez étroitement avec les parties prenantes de l’entreprise, les ML Engineers et d’autres spécialistes data afin non seulement de construire ces produits, mais aussi de les implémenter avec succès.

Vos Responsabilités


Analyser les défis et formuler des solutions basées sur les données.
Développer, entraîner et valider des modèles de machine learning et d’optimisation.
Réaliser des analyses exploratoires et du feature engineering.
Visualiser et communiquer les insights via des dashboards et du storytelling.
Collaborer avec les ML Engineers autour du MLOps et de l’opérationnalisation des modèles.
Conseiller les clients et parties prenantes sur l’utilisation de l’IA dans leur contexte.


Le profil idéal


Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans des projets de data science et de machine learning.
Maîtrise approfondie de Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, framew


orks ML/DL).


Solides bases en statistiques, SQL et design expérimental.
Expérience avec des outils de visualisation comme Power BI ou QuickSight.
Bonne compréhension du MLOps et collaboration avec des équipes techniques.
Vous êtes orienté résultats, vous pensez avec le business et vous voulez mettre des solutions en place qui fonctionnent vraiment.
Vous communiquez aisément avec des interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques, en néerlandais en français et en anglais.


Notre proposition

Une rémunération attractive : Vous bénéficiez d'un contrat à durée indéterminée, , d’un salaire attrayant et d'un ensemble d'avantages intéressants : chèques-repas de 9 euros et restaurant d’entreprise, 13e mois, prime supplémentaire en juillet, une indemnité forfaitaire nette, 100% des transports en commun remboursés, indemnité vélo, allocations familiales supplémentaires, assurance groupe, assurance hospitalisation, assurance revenu garanti, location de vélos, ...

Travail flexible : Vous travaillerez avec des horaires de travail flexibles avec possibilité de travailler à domicile jusqu’4 jours par semaine ou depuis l'un de nos bureaux régionaux.

Impact social: à La MC, vous ne faites pas que travailler. Avec vos collègues, vous contribuez directement ou indirectement à la santé de nombreuses personnes. Votre travail a une véritable signification.

Formation et possibilités de croissance: à La MC, vous êtes aux commandes de votre carrière. Vous avez la possibilité d'évoluer dans votre travail et dans l'organisation.

Team : Des collègues formidables et une culture d'entreprise dynamique et ouverte, visant à obtenir des résultats exceptionnels ensemble.

Envie de relever ce défi?

Envoyez-nous votre CV et votre lettre de motivation via le lien ci-dessous. Nous avons hâte de recevoir votre candidature !

Analyseren van businessuitdagingen en formuleren van datagedreven oplossingen.

Visualiseren en communiceren van inzichten via presentaties, dashboards en storytelling.

Title: Data Scientist - Fraud
Description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Join BNP Paribas Fortis' AI Tribe, a team of 90+ AI experts driving innovation across the bank through advanced analytics and Artificial Intelligence.

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you will design and deploy cutting-edge AI solutions to combat evolving financial crime threats. Combining machine learning, graph analytics, and Generative AI, you will transform data into actionable intelligence that helps protect our customers, strengthen the bank's resilience, and shape the future of fraud prevention.




AND IN DETAIL

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you'll design, build, and deploy AI solutions to help protect our bank and customers from evolving fraud threats. You'll work within our AI Tribe and collaborate with Fraud Operations, Risk, and Compliance teams to transform data into actionable fraud prevention and detection capabilities.




What You'll Do

Develop and enhance fraud detection models using machine learning, anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, and graph analytics.
Analyze large-scale transactional and behavioral data to uncover suspicious patterns and emerging fraud schemes.
Engineer features, enrich datasets, and apply a data-centric and error-analysis approach to continuously improve model performance.
Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into scalable AI solutions.
Investigate complex fraud cases, identify emerging attack vectors, and proactively mitigate risks.
Leverage advanced AI techniques (traditional machine learning and also LLMs and Generative AI), to support fraud investigations and strengthen fraud prevention capabilities.
Stay ahead of AI and fraud trends to continuously enhance our detection and prevention strategies




YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Education & Experience

Master’s in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or related field (PhD a plus).
3+ years in Data Science, preferably in financial services/fraud detection.
Experience with fraud analytics, AML, or financial crime prevention.




Technical Skills

Data-Centric AI & Data Engineering: Data collection, labeling, curation, enrichment, feature engineering, data quality, feedback, and large-scale data processing.




AI & Fraud Analytics:

Machine Learning: Supervised and unsupervised learning for anomaly and fraud detection, model evaluation, performance monitoring, and error analysis.
Advanced Analytics: Graph analytics, network analytics, behavioral analytics, and financial crime analytics.
Generative AI & Foundation Models: LLMs, RAG, AI agents, deep learning , transactional model and AI-driven fraud prevention solutions.
Programming & AI Engineering: Advanced Python, software engineering best practices, AI application development and deployment, monitoring, and end-to-end AI lifecycle management.




Soft Skills

Analytical, proactive, and results-driven.
Strong communicator who thrives in multidisciplinary teams.
Comfortable in an international, fast-paced environment.




Languages

Fluent English + Dutch or French (professional level).




WHAT WE HAVE TO OFFER

Sustainability and impact

We strongly believe in the positive impact that the financial sector can have on the world. BNP Paribas Fortis offers sustainable and responsible investment products and solutions and encourages social entrepreneurship. Together with our customers, we are working towards a better future every day.




DEVELOPMENT & CAREER PERSPECTIVES

We offer a wide range of training courses, workshops and webinars to choose from depending on your availability, interests and goals.




GOOD PLACE TO WORK

In addition to your remuneration and benefits (meal vouchers, insurance, holidays), we offer flexible salary options, allowing you to convert part of your salary into personalised benefits (phone use, IT equipment, transport, etc.).




OUR ENGAGEMENT

At BNP Paribas Fortis, we want to attract and retain all talent, whatever their gender, age, background or sexual orientation, and irrespective of whether they are living with a disability, as every person has their own experiences and their own identity. All of our full-time vacancies are also open to candidates wishing to work on an 80% or 90% full-time equivalent basis.




If the function is categorized as a banking services provider function (cf. Law of 22 April 2019 establishing an oath and a disciplinary regime for the banking sector), you will also need to provide us with a 'certificate of absence of professional ban' from the FSMA confirming that you are not professionally disqualified.




TEMPTED BY THE CHALLENGE?

A first selection is made based on your CV and motivation letter. Are we convinced that you are the right candidate? Then we will contact you.

Good luck!

Title: Data Scientist - GenAI
Description:
Join Artefact Belgium: Shape the Future of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)

Are you an early-career professional excited to harness the power of generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)? Artefact Belgium is seeking a Data Scientist - Gen AI to join our innovative team in Brussels. Our Belgian team specializes in LLM and GenAI projects, and this is your chance to work on cutting-edge solutions, collaborate with top-tier experts, and contribute to impactful projects in a dynamic, forward-thinking environment.

Who You Are

A recent graduate or professional with 1 to 3 years of experience, with hands-on experience working with LLMs and a passion for generative AI and NLP. Motivated to apply your technical expertise to real-world challenges in AI. Able to thrive in collaborative settings while independently driving your own workstreams. Eager to learn, grow, and push the boundaries of what's possible in AI innovation.

Who We Are

Artefact is a leading Data & AI consulting firm operating at the forefront of AI innovation. With a global presence, we help clients across industries—public health, manufacturing, etc. —leverage generative AI to achieve transformative outcomes. Our team in Belgium is specialized in LLM and GenAI projects, working on the most advanced applications of these technologies. At Artefact, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, with a strong commitment to inclusivity and employee growth.

What You Will Do


Collaborate with the team to design, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art models for client projects and internal tools.
Develop and integrate agentic AI solutions using tool calling, and emerging protocols like Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create autonomous, context-aware applications.
Research and implement innovative generative AI applications to solve complex business problems.
Design and implement comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure LLM performance, establishing quality metrics and benchmarks that guide development decisions and ensure reliable, production-ready solutions.
Optimize the performance, scalability, and usability of LLM-powered products and tools.
Contribute to the deployment and maintenance of AI systems, including models, APIs, and supporting infrastructure.
Participate in technical discussions and brainstorming sessions to shape impactful solutions.


What You Bring


A degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, physics, or a related field.
Experience working with LLMs, generative AI, or advanced NLP applications (e.g., fine-tuning models, using frameworks like Hugging Face or OpenAI).
Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with AI and NLP libraries.
Analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with an ability to address real-world challenges through AI.
Good communication skills in English, Dutch or French; additional languages are a plus.
A growth mindset, adaptability, and eagerness to work in a fast-paced, cutting-edge environment.


What We Offer


A competitive salary with benefits tailored for early-career professionals.
Hands-on experience with state-of-the-art LLM technologies in impactful projects.
A dynamic and supportive work environment that fosters creativity and professional development.
Resources for ongoing training, certification, and skill-building in generative AI and related fields.
A collaborative, inclusive workplace with access to global expertise through Artefact's network.


This position is based in Brussels.

Don't worry if you don't meet every criterion! We value passion, potential, and a commitment to innovation. If you're excited about generative AI and ready to grow your career, we'd love to hear from you!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
TL;DR

We help large enterprises cut energy costs and valorize flexibility by steering their energy use in sync with market prices and renewable generation.

We're hiring a Data Scientist to develop the forecasting, optimization, and control algorithms at the core of Companion's platform.

You'll work on energy demand forecasting, market price prediction, and real-time asset control: models and algorithms that drive second-by-second decisions worth millions.




About Companion.energy

Companion.energy connects the financial side of energy management (contracts, markets, risk) with the operational side (assets, processes, sites). We model complex energy contracts and flexible assets, forecast demand and production, and translate predictions into automated, second-by-second control decisions that move megawatts and money. Our software is used by large B2B enterprises and energy players to lower OPEX, maximize revenue, increase renewable usage, and manage risk.




Why Companion.energy?

Work on hard problems: Real-time forecasting, optimization, and closed-loop control in complex, stochastic energy systems. Your models and controllers move megawatts.
See your work in production: Models you build get deployed and measured against real financial outcomes daily. Controllers you design steer real assets in real time.
Join early, help shape the future: Small team, big impact. You'll shape Companion's data, ML, and control strategy.
A mission that matters: Better forecasting and smarter control accelerate the transition to a flexible, renewable grid.




What you'll work on

Forecasting models for energy demand, renewable production, and market prices — including the uncertainty estimates that feed downstream control.
Control algorithms that translate forecasts and market signals into real-time asset dispatch decisions (battery steering, load shifting, balancing market participation), accounting for the inherent stochasticity of prices, generation, and demand.
Optimization pipelines that schedule flexibility across portfolios of assets and markets under uncertainty.
Closing the loop: connecting prediction, planning, and execution into systems that operate autonomously in a stochastic environment.




What we are looking for

Strong foundation in machine learning, time series forecasting, and statistical modeling.
Experience with control algorithms: model predictive control (MPC), stochastic optimal control, or similar approaches to real-time decision-making under uncertainty and constraints.
Proficiency in Python and the standard data/scientific computing stack (pandas, NumPy/SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch or equivalent).
Experience with short-term power or flexibility trading
Experience working with real-world, messy time series data.
Comfort deploying models and control algorithms in production environments, not just notebooks.
Interest in or knowledge of energy systems: electricity markets, load forecasting, asset dispatch, balancing mechanisms, or related domains.
Pragmatic approach: you understand the difference between a theoretically optimal solution and one that ships and delivers value under real-world uncertainty.
Experience with mathematical optimization (linear/quadratic programming, mixed-integer formulations, stochastic programming) is a strong plus.




Location

Belgium (hybrid)




How we hire

Intro call → technical case → follow-up conversations with the team and founders.

We keep it simple and can move fast.




Ready to apply?

Send a short email to apply@companion.energy with your resume attached. Tell us why this role excites you and share something relevant: a model you built, a control system you designed, a Kaggle notebook, or a project that shows how you approach data and engineering problems.

  • Work on hard problems: Real-time forecasting, optimization, and closed-loop control in complex, stochastic energy systems. Your models and controllers move megawatts.
  • See your work in production: Models you build get deployed and measured against real financial outcomes daily. Controllers you design steer real assets in real time.
  • Join early, help shape the future: Small team, big impact. You'll shape Companion's data, ML, and control strategy.
  • A mission that matters: Better forecasting and smarter control accelerate the transition to a flexible, renewable grid.


What you'll work on

  • Forecasting models for energy demand, renewable production, and market prices — including the uncertainty estimates that feed downstream control.
  • Control algorithms that translate forecasts and market signals into real-time asset dispatch decisions (battery steering, load shifting, balancing market participation), accounting for the inherent stochasticity of prices, generation, and demand.
  • Optimization pipelines that schedule flexibility across portfolios of assets and markets under uncertainty.
  • Closing the loop: connecting prediction, planning, and execution into systems that operate autonomously in a stochastic environment.


What we are looking for

  • Strong foundation in machine learning, time series forecasting, and statistical modeling.
  • Experience with control algorithms: model predictive control (MPC), stochastic optimal control, or similar approaches to real-time decision-making under uncertainty and constraints.
  • Proficiency in Python and the standard data/scientific computing stack (pandas, NumPy/SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch or equivalent).
  • Experience with short-term power or flexibility trading
  • Experience working with real-world, messy time series data.
  • Comfort deploying models and control algorithms in production environments, not just notebooks.
  • Interest in or knowledge of energy systems: electricity markets, load forecasting, asset dispatch, balancing mechanisms, or related domains.
  • Pragmatic approach: you understand the difference between a theoretically optimal solution and one that ships and delivers value under real-world uncertainty.
  • Experience with mathematical optimization (linear/quadratic programming, mixed-integer formulations, stochastic programming) is a strong plus.


Location

Belgium (hybrid)


How we hire

Intro call → technical case → follow-up conversations with the team and founders.

We keep it simple and can move fast.


Ready to apply?

Send a short email to apply@companion.energy with your resume attached. Tell us why this role excites you and share something relevant: a model you built, a control system you designed, a Kaggle notebook, or a project that shows how you approach data and engineering problems.

Title: Job | GenAI - Data Scientist | Brussel
Description:
Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

AI- & ML-solution development


Machine learning- en deep learning-modellen (inclusief generative AI) inzetten om complexe bedrijfsproblemen op te lossen.
Modellen optimaliseren voor prestaties, schaalbaarheid en kostenefficiëntie in Azure-cloudomgevingen.
MLOps-pijplijnen implementeren om modeltraining, validatie en uitrol te automatiseren.



Cloud- & AI-infrastructuur


Schaalbare AI-infrastructuur ontwikkelen en onderhouden op Azure-cloudplatformen, gebruikmakend van diensten zoals Azure ML en AKS.
Zorgen voor veilige, conforme en hoog-beschikbare AI-implementaties in de cloud.



Generatieve AI & Innovatie


Generative AI-modellen (LLM’s, enz.) verkennen en integreren voor toepassingen zoals: RAG, intelligent document processing, speech-to-text en conversational AI.
Vooroplopen in AI-trends (bijv. fine-tuning, multimodal AI) en innovatieve use cases voorstellen.



Data- & modelgovernance


Zorgen voor datakwaliteit, bias-mitigatie en ethische AI-praktijken bij modelontwikkeling.
Modelmonitoring en explainability-tools implementeren om prestaties en compliance te volgen.



Samenwerking & stakeholder engagement


Samenwerken met productteams, data scientists en zakelijke stakeholders om AI-kansen te identificeren.
Zakelijke vereisten vertalen naar technische AI-oplossingen en inzichten effectief communiceren.



De job in een notendop

Je speelt een centrale rol in het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van geavanceerde AI- en machine learning-oplossingen die innovatie en automatisering binnen de organisatie stimuleren.

Je werkt samen met cross-functionele teams om cloudgebaseerde AI-diensten, generatieve AI en schaalbare ML-infrastructuur te benutten.

Je zorgt ervoor dat AI-modellen robuust, ethisch verantwoord en afgestemd zijn op de bedrijfsdoelstellingen.

Jij hoeft geen witte raaf te zijn

Al kan je er bij ons wel één worden. Bij ons mag je volop je vleugels uitslaan als je iemand bent met:


Een master of doctoraat in de wetenschappen met uitstekende academische resultaten op technisch gebied (econometrie, computerwetenschappen, artificiële intelligentie, e.a.).
Deskundigheid op het vlak van
machine learning technieken en bereidheid om die kennis up-to-date te houden; een diepgaande kennis van algoritmes zoals Random Forests, Neural Networks en reinforcement learning is hierbij een must.
genAI: prompt engineering, structured outputs, ...(zie verantwoordelijkheden).

Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python en SQL.
Uitgebreide kennis van Nederlands of Frans, met passieve kennis van de andere taal, en Engels.
Ervaring in het verklaren van complexe analyses aan een niet-technisch publiek aan de hand van je verhalende competenties en je capaciteit om data te visualiseren; je beschikt over uitmuntende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden op technisch en businessniveau.
Honger naar kennis, niet alleen om nieuwe algoritmes en technologieën te beheersen, maar ook op interpersoonlijk vlak; je bent je ervan bewust dat de waarde van jouw werk neerkomt op kwaliteit x acceptatie en je wilt sleutelen aan beide aspecten.
Uitzonderlijke probleemoplossende vaardigheden: je weet dat het juiste inzicht in een probleem minstens 90% van de oplossing uitmaakt, je geeft blijk van creativiteit en volharding bij het doorgronden van problemen en het zoeken van oplossingen.


Je scoort extra met:


Tweetaligheid (Engels en Nederlands of Frans).
Ervaring met het bouwen van dataproducten, van ontwerp tot productie.
Wat full-stack skills.
Kennis van cloud, bij voorkeur Azure.



Belfius koestert zijn talenten

Behalve de kans om elke dag te shinen, bieden wij jou een fulltime contract van onbepaalde duur met:


Een mooi loon aangevuld met een innovatief aanbod om een persoonlijk budget samen te stellen dat je kan besteden volgens je voorkeuren (bv. wagen, fiets, pc, smartphone, tablet, huisvesting onder bepaalde voorwaarden) en extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, personeelsvoordeel op eigen producten en diensten, en een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
Mogelijkheden te over om je te ontwikkelen door een brede waaier aan opleidingen en carrièrekansen in de hele Belfius-groep.
Een goede werk-privé balans dankzij flexibele uren, de combinatie kantoor- en thuiswerk en een aantrekkelijk aantal vakantiedagen.
Een moderne werkplek in het hart van Brussel met een coole fitness, een lekker gezond restaurant en gezellige ontmoetingsruimtes, dit alles op wandelafstand van de winkelstraat, het treinstation Brussel-Noord en de metrohalte Rogier.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Tribe Artificial Intelligence aims to deliver an efficient and seamless banking experience for our customers and empower our employees through AI. Our expert team of approximately 100 experts includes Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, Product Owners and Managers. We are seeking a Data Scientist with a minimum of 3 years of experience in developing AI applications, including both generative and traditional AI.




AND IN DETAIL

You develop AI applications to address various business challenges, including virtual assistants to enhance client experiences, advanced AI tools to support employee efficiency and creativity, and automating and optimizing internal processes.
You use various analytical methods, including large language models (prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, …), Speech AI, agentic AI, image generation and interpretation, and classical statistical/machine learning techniques. While we don't expect you to be an expert in all areas, you should possess very strong expertise in core technologies and the ability to learn new methods as required.
You ensure scientific rigor in delivered solutions by applying robust methodologies, evaluating model generalization performance, adopting data-centric approaches through error analysis and data curation or augmentation, selecting relevant frameworks, and adhering to responsible AI guideline.
You present the results of your work directly to stakeholders and managers.
You contribute to deploying AI applications in production using a comprehensive stack of tools.
You access one of the richest volumes of varied data in the market and apply your skills to it.
You evolve in an environment where innovation and lean processes are praised, straight-forward communication is encouraged, and peers understand the meaning of team up.
You work with a team of colleagues in an Agile organization who are ready to collaborate and to share their experience.




YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

You hold at least a Master’s degree in a quantitative field like statistics, computer science or engineering, with a focus on natural language processing. A PhD is advantageous. Candidates from other academic backgrounds with strong analytics knowledge are also welcome.
You have a minimum of 3 years’ experience in data science, preferably in the financial sector, though less experience may be accepted if your academic achievements are substantial.
You are fluent in English and have a good command of French and/or Dutch.
You are proficient in Python for model building and understand ML engineering fundamentals (e.g., versioning systems) to produce code ready for CI/CD pipelines.




WHAT WE HAVE TO OFFER

OUR IMPACT

We strongly believe in the positive impact that the financial sector can have on the world. BNP Paribas Fortis offers sustainable and responsible investment products and solutions and encourages social entrepreneurship. Together with our customers, we are working towards a better future every day.




YOUR CAREER PERSPECTIVES

We offer a wide range of training courses, workshops and webinars to choose from depending on your availability, interests and goals.




OUR OFFER

In addition to your remuneration and benefits (meal vouchers, insurance, holidays), we offer flexible salary options, allowing you to convert part of your salary into personalised benefits (phone use, IT equipment, transport, etc.).




OUR ENGAGEMENT

At BNP Paribas Fortis, we want to attract and retain all talent, whatever their gender, age, background or sexual orientation, and irrespective of whether they are living with a disability, as every person has their own experiences and their own identity. All of our full-time vacancies are also open to candidates wishing to work on an 80% or 90% full-time equivalent basis.




If the function is categorized as a banking services provider function (cf. Law of 22 April 2019 establishing an oath and a disciplinary regime for the banking sector), you will also need to provide us with a 'certificate of absence of professional ban' from the FSMA confirming that you are not professionally disqualified.




TEMPTED BY THE CHALLENGE?

A first selection is made based on your CV and motivation letter. Are we convinced that you are the right candidate? Then we will contact you. Good luck!

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Commodity Trading and Risk Management
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, mental health, and vision coverage for you, your spouse/partner, and children.


Your Impact

You will leverage your creativity and problem-solving skills to tackle clients’ most pressing issues using an analytical lens, meeting client needs and communicating your work to executive audiences.

Client counterparts span a wide range of audiences and functions from treasury and risk professionals, marketing & sales teams, procurement category managers, to high-level stakeholders (e.g., CFO). When working internally, you will build innovative algorithms and products (what we call “IP development”) to best meet our most common client needs, from building price forecasting models for commodities markets, to brainstorming and developing new offers and solutions to support future clients. You will also work with our engineers to design new interfaces to deliver faster, more impactful insights to our clients.

Your work on the team will primarily be in applying advanced analytics to enable better commodity risk management decisions. For example, you might work as the lead in maintaining and expanding existing hedging strategies by re-training existing models through process driven approaches. You might also modify and improve algorithm performance across market regimes, by introducing new features, data sources, and modelling approaches; rapidly identify opportunities for our clients to increase earnings potential and reduce downside risk by back testing various risk management strategies; co-build bespoke tools with client data science teams that tailor machine-learning algorithms to attain an optimal balance of earnings and volatility given clients’ risk appetite and capital constraints; and/or collaborate with and train cross-functional client teams to instill long-lasting capabilities and ensure new decision-making models are embraced by organizations.

You will receive best-in-class training in structuring business problems and serving as a client adviser and have opportunities to work closely with and learn from our senior commodity and risk practitioners, as well as industry players that are shaping the future of commodity markets and trading. You will get access to unparalleled career acceleration, with a huge amount of ownership and responsibility from the get-go in a collaborative, diverse, non-hierarchical environment. You will get the opportunity to travel to client sites, locally and around the world (once travel resumes). Lastly, you will be able to provide direct and measurable impact to some of the largest organizations in agribusiness, materials, energy, industrial, and consumer foods sectors around the globe.

As a member of the Commodity Analytics team, you will be based in one of the following offices: Brussels, Amsterdam, Madrid or Lisbon. You’ll work closely with McKinsey’s Commodity Trading Service Line to support clients across sectors and geographies.

Commodity Analytics helps commodity producers, processors, buyers, and traders across agriculture/softs, metals, energy, and consumer sectors improve commodity price risk capabilities with cutting-edge data science.

Title: Consultant Senior - Data Science & AI (Trilingual NL/EN/FR)
Description:
Senior Data Scientist, AI & Machine Learning | Brussels




At Exsolvæ, our consultants carry the title of Solver, and it's a title you earn. We take the development of every Solver seriously, each one belongs to a Core Domain, works with a Leader who actually follows their progress, and presents their work in Cerebro sessions to colleagues who know the field as well as they do. It's a demanding place, on purpose.




The Data Science & AI Core Domain serves some of the biggest names across finance, retail, automotive, ... clients who run AI in production and pay dearly when a model gets it wrong.




That's the work we're hiring for.




Your role, on mission

Design and build AI applications that create measurable value for customers and employees, from intelligent automation to decision support
Own the full lifecycle: framing use cases with business stakeholders, prototyping, production deployment, monitoring
Set up rigorous evaluation: reference datasets, quality metrics and the safeguards that keep models reliable in production
Work in agile squads and present your results directly to senior management




Your role, within the community

Share what you learn: Cerebro sessions, co-built playbooks, code reviews between Solvers
Mentor peers and be mentored: seniors who enjoy passing on what they know do well here
Help shape where the Core Domain goes next




Must-haves

Master's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, engineering, computer science); a PhD is an asset
Senior profile: minimum 5 years of professional experience in data science and analytics
A proven track record of AI applications shipped to production, including at least one agentic AI solution (LLM-based agents, orchestration, tool use) that you can walk us through in detail
Expert Python with solid engineering practices (git, testing, production-grade code)
Hands-on experience with deep learning and modern model architectures
Trilingual, mandatory: fluent English, fluent French or Dutch, and full professional proficiency in the other national language (FR or NL)
Based in Belgium and available on-site in Brussels roughly half the time
A genuine desire to be part of a community: you share what you know and you show up for the collective moments




Strong assets

Agent orchestration frameworks: LangGraph, MCP, Google ADK
LLM evaluation and safety: guardrails, red teaming
Natural language processing and speech technologies
On-premise model deployment in regulated environments
MLOps: monitoring, testing and delivery pipelines for models
Enterprise data science platforms, SQL, bash
Financial services background




Joining Exsolvæ, concretely

A community before anything else: a Core Domain led by a Leader who follows your development, Cerebro sessions where Solvers present and learn, playbooks built together
A Knowledge & Networking budget to keep learning and stay plugged into the ecosystem (emerging AI topics, MLOps, AI governance)
A followed career path with a dedicated Manager, regular check-ins, an evolution committee that formalises your progression and issue recommandations
Long-run missions at leading companies, in production
A permanent employee contract, with a competitive package aligned with your seniority




Interested, or know someone who fits? Apply here or reach out to us!

Title: Medior Data Scientist
Description:
Over de functie

Voor een geavanceerde farmaceutische omgeving zoeken we een Medior Data Scientist / Engineer die wil bijdragen aan de digitale transformatie van een moderne productieomgeving. De site behoort tot de internationale top en richt zich op de productie van actieve farmaceutische ingrediënten (API’s) en eindproducten die wereldwijd worden ingezet.

De organisatie investeert sterk in Industry 4.0, data-gedreven werken en procesoptimalisatie. Binnen dit kader speelt het Smart Factory-team een sleutelrol in het ontwikkelen van slimme, schaalbare oplossingen die productieprocessen efficiënter, veiliger en betrouwbaarder maken.

Jouw missie

Als Medior Data Scientist / Engineer werk je mee aan het ontwikkelen en implementeren van data-oplossingen die een directe impact hebben op productieprestaties. Je vertaalt complexe datasets naar concrete verbeteringen en ondersteunt operationele teams met inzichten en innovatieve toepassingen, waaronder machine learning en AI.

Je werkt nauw samen met procesingenieurs, kwaliteitsspecialisten en IT-professionals.

Verantwoordelijkheden

Data & Analyse


Verzamelen, verwerken en analyseren van grote hoeveelheden productiedata uit diverse bronnen (o.a. proceshistorians, MES-systemen en sensoren)
Ontwikkelen van robuuste data pipelines en analytische modellen in Python en SQL
Uitvoeren van statistische analyses en root cause analyses ter ondersteuning van procesverbetering



Machine Learning & AI


Ontwerpen, trainen en valideren van machine learning modellen (o.a. predictive maintenance, anomaliedetectie, procesoptimalisatie)
Verkennen en toepassen van AI- en LLM-oplossingen binnen een productiecontext (bijv. documentverwerking en kennisextractie)
Monitoren en continu verbeteren van modelprestaties



Smart Factory Initiatieven


Actief bijdragen aan digitale roadmap en innovatieprojecten
Samenwerken met multidisciplinaire teams om data-oplossingen te vertalen naar operationele waarde
Documenteren van modellen en methodologieën volgens kwaliteits- en compliancevereisten



Stakeholdermanagement


Vertalen van complexe data-inzichten naar begrijpelijke communicatie voor niet-technische stakeholders
Ondersteunen van adoptie en verandering bij de implementatie van nieuwe tools en processen



Vereiste kwalificaties

Opleiding


Bachelor- of masterdiploma in Data Science, Informatica, Ingenieurswetenschappen, Toegepaste Wiskunde of een gelijkaardig domein



Technische vaardigheden


Python (o.a. pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) voor data-analyse en modellering
SQL en ervaring met relationele databases
Machine learning (supervised, unsupervised, time-series)
Kennis van Large Language Models en relevante toepassingen (bijv. fine-tuning, prompt engineering, agents)
Ervaring met industriële data-omgevingen en IIoT-context is een plus



Professionele competenties


2 tot 5 jaar relevante ervaring in data science of analytics
Sterk analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen
Zelfstandig kunnen werken en tegelijk goed functioneren in teamverband
Resultaatgericht, nauwkeurig en in staat prioriteiten te stellen
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels



Pluspunten

Ervaring met één of meerdere van onderstaande is een meerwaarde:


Industriële dataplatformen en procesdata-infrastructuur (bijv. PI System)
Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)
Geavanceerde analysetools voor tijdreeksdata
Distributed Control Systems (DCS)
Ervaring met ontwikkelomgevingen en moderne AI-codetools



Daarnaast is ervaring binnen een gereguleerde omgeving (bijv. farmaceutische, biotech- of chemische sector) een sterke troef.

Reference #: INCA27877

As a Quantitative Modeler, you will be developing, validating and implementing advanced mathematical and statistical models to address complex financial and business challenges. Quantitative and qualitative problem-solving skills, with high capacity for solving challenging business problems
Present complex quantitative concepts and findings in a clear and accessible manner to stakeholders at various levels of technical expertise.
Strong analytical thinking and a drive for continuous learning and improvement, tech-savvy

Title: Senior AI Data Scientist, Agentic Automation (Marketing)
Description:
Company Overview

team.blue is the market leader in enabling digital success for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) across Europe, catering to over 3 million customers in 25+ languages. Our mission is to make online business success simpler, by providing our customers with all the tools and resources they need to excel online and remain ahead of the curve.

Position Overview

We are looking for a senior data scientist to streamline marketing operations at team.blue, by building agentic systems to run them. You would report into the Applied AI team and work on marketing automation projects.

Marketing here runs across many brands, markets and languages, on a stack that differs brand by brand. The work spans competitive and pricing monitoring, performance reporting and diagnosis, SEO and AI-answer visibility, content refresh, localisation and lifecycle production, paid search and social account hygiene, and tracking and consent QA. Each of these is a multi-step process across several systems, repeated per brand.

The method you will follow matters more than the domain: map processes, quantify the time and resources they consume, determine the ROI impact of agentic automation, build a proof of concept, take it to production and measure the impact of your work. This is closer to building autonomous, business-impact systems than to building pure single purpose models.

What We Are Actually Screening For

Classical ML and applied statistics are the entry fee for this role, necessary and assumed. Everyone we are talking to has them.

Four things separate candidates.

Can you build an agent someone should trust. Most of these agents produce a judgment, backed by numbers: this page lost traffic because of a SERP change, this brand under-converts relative to a comparable one, this competitor’s pricing move matters. A confidently wrong judgment gets read and acted on across several markets before anyone checks it. Lots of this is irreversible, so a recommendation nobody can reconstruct the reasoning for is worse than no recommendation, because it costs trust. Calibration, provenance and auditable workflows are key components of the systems we develop, not a compliance layer on top of them.

Can you tell whether the data underneath is worth reasoning over. These agents read from analytics, search console, ad platforms, CRM and third-party SEO and social tools. Tracking is inconsistent across brands, UTM conventions are followed unevenly, and tags break silently. An agent built on that without checking will generate fluent nonsense at scale. Part of the work is refusing to build on a source until it is trustworthy, and saying so with evidence.

Can you reshape a request. You will be handed requests written by domain experts, and some of them will be the wrong shape: an agent asked to do something a query would do better, or scoped to advise where it could act. We need someone who can understand that, explain better ways to structure the process, and propose a version that works, rather than building what was asked and shipping a thing nobody uses.

Can you take it to production yourself. We mean end to end literally. You write it, you containerise it, you instrument it, and you deploy it with minimal guidance from the devops teams. If the last three things you built were Jupyter notebooks handed to someone else to productionise, this is the wrong role, and no amount of modelling depth compensates.

Your day would involve


Sitting with an SEO or paid search owner and mapping how a traffic-drop investigation actually runs today across brands, then attaching hours per week to each step of it
Extracting requirements live from people who do not think in data models
Designing the state transitions: what triggers, what branches, which APIs get called, where it waits for a human, and what happens when step 4 of 9 fails or a vendor rate-limits you mid-run
Building the guardrails before the capability: dry-run mode, an approval gate ahead of anything that writes to a live account or publishes externally, least-privilege API scopes, a documented undo
Deciding where a human stays in the loop, at what confidence threshold, and designing a review queue marketers will open a second time
Writing evals for output that precision and recall do not capture: is the diagnosis correct, is the cited source real and does it say what the agent claims, does a generated brief hold brand voice in Greek and Dutch as well as in English
Checking whether the tracking data an agent depends on is sound before building on it, and quantifying the error when it is not
Wiring an agent to a webhook or a scheduled trigger, and making the handler idempotent so a retry does not double-post a recommendation or apply the same keyword exclusion twice
Deciding which steps in a flow warrant a frontier model and which run on something cheap, then proving that routing decision with numbers, because these flows run daily across many brands and the bill compounds
Sitting in a vendor demo asking what their API actually exposes, what the rate limits and quotas are, what their data model looks like, and what integration really costs us



What You Will Bring


7+ years building data and ML systems in industry, spanning both sides of the LLM shift. We want the judgment that comes from having debugged systems before you could ask a model what was wrong.
Somewhere in that history: you have been the only person who did a job end to end. First or only data hire, the single ML person in a small company, or a one-person function inside a large one. We are less interested in company stage than in the condition, because it is what forces someone to map the process, build it, deploy it and answer for it rather than hand each part to a specialist.
Somewhere in that history: you have shipped something with permission to act on live systems affecting real customers, and you can tell us what you did to sleep at night.
Expert in Python and ML.
You ship end to end. Python someone else can still read in six months, a current toolchain (uv, Docker or an equivalent, we care that you re-examine your tooling, not which tool you landed on), your own container, your own instrumentation.
Production experience with multi-step, tool-calling LLM workflows: orchestration, retries, idempotency, timeouts, partial-failure recovery. State-machine design, not only train/serve pipelines.
Integration against third-party APIs you do not control. Auth flows, rate limits, pagination, sandbox behaviour that differs from production, and schema changes shipped without notice.
Cost and latency engineering as a first-class concern: model routing, caching, batching, and the instinct to know what a flow costs per run before Finance asks.
A safety instinct for systems that take actions: staging modes, approval gates, least-privilege scoping, a way back.
Evaluation design for generative and agentic output: LLM-as-judge, golden-transcript regression suites, red-teaming. Including calibration: an agent that reports high confidence needs to be right at that rate, and you can show whether it is.
Process mapping and quantification. You can sit with a domain expert, capture what actually happens rather than what the policy says, and attach hours to it.
Technical vendor evaluation. Judging a martech vendor on API surface, data model, extensibility and true integration cost, not on the sales deck.



Nice to have


Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning or a related field
PromptOps at scale: versioning, testing and rollback of prompts and models as production artefacts
Prior exposure to martech, ad-tech or SEO tooling and their APIs, or to automation in any domain where output is customer-facing
Experience evaluating generated output across multiple languages



Right to work

At any stage, please be prepared to provide proof of eligibility to work in the country you are applying for. Unfortunately, we are unable to support relocation packages or sponsor visas.

Come as you are

Everyone is welcome here. Diversity and inclusion are at our core. Far above any technical competence, we value respect, openness, and trusted collaboration. We do not tolerate intolerance.

team.blue is a leading digital enabler for companies and entrepreneurs. It serves over 3.3 million customers in Europe and has more than 3,000 experts to support them. Its goal is to shape technology and to empower businesses with innovative digital services.

Title: Fraud Data Analyst
Description:
EBA CLEARING is a provider of pan-European payment infrastructure solutions. Founded in 1998, the Company is owned by 48 of the major banks operating in Europe and based on a country-neutral governance model. The payment systems of EBA CLEARING are pan-European by design and desire: they are developed in close co-operation with the Company’s multinational user community and best-of-breed technology partners.

Join our team of smart and curious people from all over the world as we help shape the future of pan-European payments.




This position can be located in Brussels or Frankfurt.




The position




The FPAD Competence Centre (FCC) is responsible for the development and maintenance of fraud detection models for EBA CLEARING FPAD functionality. This requires data analysis and modelling as well as a good understanding of fraud developments and the needs of our users, supporting them in understanding FPAD functioning and results and help investigate specific cases.




As a member of the FCC team your responsibilities will include:




monitoring model and data quality in production
finding new emerging fraud characteristics by exploring the vast transaction data underlying our FPAD solution
building new features that help detect fraudulent transactions
developing state-of-the-art AI models against billions of historical transaction
creating documentation and charts to explain your work to our users
sharing insights with experts from financial institutions across Europe
staying up to date with latest trends in fraud detection and drive the development of our solution




The profile




The basics:

University degree in computer science, mathematics or a related field
At least three years of experience working in a quantitative role, in a fraud or risk environment at a bank or payment service provider
Good knowledge of data science and data engineering, preferably with python
Especially experience with
Experience to optimise models on response time
Working in a highly regulated environment
Domain knowledge in payment data
Full proficiency in English, any additional European languages would be an asset




Required skills:

Intercultural communication
Customer-first attitude in everyday responsibilities
Analytical thinking and efficient problem-solving
Ability to anticipate problems, needs and changes and evaluate operational risks

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Our Business

team.blue is an ecosystem of successful brands working together across regions to provide customers with everything they need to succeed online. 60+ successful brands make up the group; with a team of more than 3000+ experts serving its 3.5 million customers across Europe and beyond.

team.blue's brands are a mix of traditional hosting businesses, offering services from domain names, email, shared hosting, e-commerce and server hosting solutions and specialist SaaS providers offering adjacent products such as compliance, marketing tools and team collaboration products. This broad product offering makes it a one-stop partner for online businesses and entrepreneurs across Europe.

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Science to join our Data & Analytics team. In this role you will lead a team of two data scientists while staying hands-on in delivery yourself. You will bring not only technical expertise but also a deep understanding of business operations and strategy. The work you and your team produce will directly influence decision-making and help shape the future of our organization through actionable insights drawn from complex datasets.

As a Data Science Lead, you will set the direction and priorities for the team, coach your data scientists in their technical and professional growth, and personally own the most complex projects end to end. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business leaders, product managers, and engineers, to design and implement data-driven solutions that align with the company’s goals, translating complex data into business value through machine learning, predictive modeling, and statistical analysis.

This is deliberately a hybrid role. We are not looking for someone who only directs work: you will spend a meaningful share of your time building models, writing code and reviewing your team’s output, and you should want to keep it that way.

Key Responsibilities:


Team Leadership & Development: Lead, coach and grow a team of two data scientists — setting objectives, holding regular one-to-ones, giving feedback, and actively supporting their technical and career development.
Hands-on Delivery: Stay personally involved in delivery, owning the most complex or business-critical projects end to end and setting the technical standard for the team through code reviews and pairing.
Planning & Prioritisation: Manage the team’s backlog and capacity, balance competing stakeholder requests, and make sure work is delivered at a predictable pace and quality.
Business Insight Development: Understand the key business challenges and opportunities, and use data to develop solutions that align with strategic objectives.
Data Strategy: Own the data science roadmap together with leadership, defining priorities based on business needs and opportunities, and translating them into a concrete plan for your team.
Predictive Modeling & Machine Learning: Build, deploy, and maintain machine learning models to forecast trends, optimize processes, and drive business outcomes.
Data Analysis & Visualization: Analyze large, complex datasets to extract actionable insights, and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Data science pipeline: Advise, build and continuously improve the data science pipeline which best responds to team.blue analytics needs.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with business leaders, product teams, and engineers to ensure that data solutions meet business requirements.
Continuous Improvement: Stay up to date with the latest trends in data science, AI, and machine learning to continuously improve the team’s capabilities.



Requirements:


Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in data science, including at least 3 years in a data science lead, team lead or equivalent leadership position, with a proven track record of solving complex business problems using data.
Proven Leadership Experience: Demonstrable experience line-managing and developing data scientists. You can point to concrete examples of people you have hired, coached or grown, and of teams you have led through delivery.
Hands-on Credibility: You are still actively building — comfortable writing production-quality code, reviewing your team’s work, and being the person others come to when a problem is genuinely hard.
Stakeholder Management: Experience representing a data science team to senior stakeholders: setting expectations, saying no when needed, and defending the team’s priorities.
Strong understanding of business operations and the ability to align data science projects with business objectives.
Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical insights into business recommendations and communicate with stakeholders at all levels.
Problem-solving: Strong analytical thinking with the ability to handle complex and unstructured data.
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or Scala.
Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, Scikit-learn).
Experience with SQL and working with large data sets.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and big data tools (e.g., Hadoop, Spark).).



"Come as you are"

Everyone is welcome here. Diversity & Inclusion are at our core. Far above any technical competence, we value respect, openness, and trusted collaboration. We do not tolerate intolerance.

Title: Senior Consultant in Data Science
Description:
Belgium (Policy Consulting) / Full-time / Permanent employee







Technopolis Group is looking to grow its data science team. We are now looking to recruit a motivated and experienced specialist to join our Brussels team as a Senior Consultant.




ABOUT TECHNOPOLIS




Founded in 1989, Technopolis Group is an independent research and consultancy company, European leader in providing strategic policy advice to public sector institutions at the local, regional, national, and international levels (such as the European institutions) – as well as to third sector organisations, public-private partnerships and research organisations.




Our Group is active in many areas such as R&I, Health, Higher Education, Green economy, Industry and entrepreneurship, Regional and urban development, Digital economy and Open science.




We have grown steadily over the past 30 years and have and a track record of over 4,000 projects. Technopolis Group has offices in ten European cities and offices in Colombia (Bogotà) and Ivory Coast (Abidjan). Our team of consultants brings an educational mix in a variety of policy, social, environmental science disciplines, and linguistic richness, originating from 40+countries and covering 30+ languages.




For more information: www.technopolis-group.com




THE TEAM




The selected person will be part of the Technopolis Group Data Science Unit (DSU), whose members work in different country offices. The growing team of DSU data scientists have diversified academic backgrounds but a shared passion for developing data science applications to improve policymaking. The unit works in policy consulting jobs for our clients but also conducts R&D to develop new, untested and exciting applications, potentially in collaboration with internal and external partners.




The DSU is active in all types of data science applications in policymaking. See https://www.technopolis-group.com/solutions/data-analytics/. Examples include record linkage, building classifiers, semantic and sentiment analysis, web scraping and dynamic visualisations. Additionally, the team is looking forward to expanding its portfolio of techniques using real-time indicators, causal AI and generative AI. Experience in these last techniques, or a general understanding of their functioning combined with a demonstrable willingness to master them, is highly desirable.







ABOUT THIS JOB




Main tasks

The typical tasks of the Senior Consultant in data science are:

Leading the design and implementation of suitable data science methodologies
Perform analyses to answer policy questions leveraging R, Python and other programming and data science tools
Write own code to perform analyses
Extract and transform data from multiple sources, and develop processes for data cleaning, integration, and validation
Develop dashboards using visualization tools such as Tableau / PowerBI to communicate findings
Report on the findings and present to clients







YOUR PROFILE




Experience and skills

Applicants suitable for a Senior Consultant in data science position should have:

Master’s Degree in data science, Computer Science or related subjects
A minimum of five (5) years of professional experience in a consulting or research environment in data science
Proficient in R and Python
Experience with NLP and text knowledge extraction
Knowledge and interest in Machine Learning methods including classification, clustering and predictive modelling
Hands-on experience using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) programmatically through APIs, including their integration into automated data processing, text analysis and knowledge-extraction pipelines
A very good knowledge of economics and statistics, together with familiarity with business, industrial and innovation-related data, is essential to ensure analytical outputs are interpreted and communicated in a policy-relevant way.
Proven experience in designing composite indicators and scoreboards and hands-on knowledge of the COINr package, is a major asset.
Knowledge of various open data sources, the collaborative platform Github, database consolidation and processing and web scraping
A general overview of the Science Technology and Innovation domain and proven track in working together with policymakers in this area is desirable
Applicants should have good communication skills and be able to work in an international and multicultural environment







OUR OFFER




What we offer

A full time, permanent position
An attractive salary package with benefits including hospitalisation insurance and a pension scheme
A positive working atmosphere within a team of like-minded professionals in Brussels, while also being part of a larger international Group with multiple opportunities for international cooperation
Good opportunities for career progression, from both a content perspective (thought leaders, methodological specialists) and in the areas of business development and company leadership




Interested? Apply directly




We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons with a residency and work permit in Belgium.







HOW TO APPLY




Applications can be done directly on Technopolis website or sent to recruitment_be@technopolis-group.com (reference: DS26) and include a cover letter and an Europass-style CV.




Application deadline: 09 October 2026. Early applications are encouraged. Applications will be assessed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.




Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.




Applicants should have the EU citizenship or a valid work permit to apply.










ABOUT US




At Technopolis Group, we began our journey as pioneers in the evaluation of science, technology and innovation policies. While evaluation remains a cornerstone of our identity, we’ve evolved into a trusted partner for evidence-based decision-making across a wide spectrum of policy areas.




Today, our multidisciplinary experts offer strategic advice, forward-looking foresight, and robust project and network management, even in the most complex contexts. We combine cutting-edge data analytics with a deep understanding of policy to deliver insights that are both rigorous and actionable. From assessing policy effectiveness to measuring impact and communicating results to diverse audiences, we ensure clarity, relevance and reach.




We don’t believe in one-size-fits-all solutions. Instead, we collaborate closely with our clients to design tailored approaches that truly meet their needs.

Our work spans the globe and the governance spectrum, partnering with international institutions such as the European Commission and multilateral development banks, as well as with national, regional and local authorities. We also support universities, research centres, business networks, clusters, and incubators, helping them navigate complexity and drive impact.

Title: Principal Computational Methodologist (Belgium)
Description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for a Principal Computational Methodologist who is curious, collaborative, and impact-driven to join our Advanced Methods and Data Science team within Biometrics and Data Science, based in any of our Brussels (Belgium), Slough (UK) or Raleigh (US).




About The Role

You will help shape how advanced AI, machine learning, and computational methods support clinical development. You will design, validate, and deploy models that help teams make evidence-based decisions in areas such as biomarker discovery, clinical trial design, operational efficiency, and patient experience. You will guide scientific thinking, turn complex methods into practical solutions, and help build scalable tools that meet scientific, technical, and regulatory expectations.




Who You Will Work With

You will join Advanced Methods and Data Science, part of Biometrics and Data Science within Patient Evidence. You will work with clinical, statistical, molecular, operational, engineering, IT, governance, and compliance colleagues across countries. You will also connect with academic, technology, and industry partners. Together, you will explore new methods, share scientific learning, and support teams that use data to improve decision-making across the drug development value chain.




What You Will Do

You will lead AI and machine learning projects that address clinical development, biomarker, operational, and decision-support needs.
You will design, build, test, and refine modern deep learning models for text, graphs, biological sequences, and clinical data.
You will develop generative AI applications using foundation models, pre-trained models, and large language models.
You will run rigorous, reproducible AI experiments on internal and public datasets to generate publishable scientific results.
You will partner with engineering teams to package methods into applications, platforms, and scalable validated solutions.
You will mentor colleagues, share knowledge, and represent the team through publications, presentations, and external collaborations.




Interested? For this role, we are looking for the following education, experience, and skills:

You have a PhD in Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Computational Biology, Statistical Genetics, Mathematics, or a related scientific field.
You bring experience in industry, ideally within pharma, clinical development, life sciences, or another regulated data-focused environment.
You can program confidently in Python, R, or similar languages, and you can support others with practical coding guidance.
You understand supervised, unsupervised, Bayesian, and deep learning methods, and can apply them to real-world scientific questions.
You have experience with ML infrastructure, reproducible research, Linux or HPC environments, and software or platform development.
You communicate clearly with scientific, technical, medical, and business partners, and enjoy working in a collaborative, multidisciplinary team.

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!




About Us

UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.




Why work with us?

At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless expressly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Should you require any adjustments to our process to assist you in demonstrating your strengths and capabilities contact us on EMEA-Reasonable_Accommodation@ucb.com. Please note should your enquiry not relate to adjustments; we will not be able to support you through this channel.

Title: Junior Data Scientist
Description:
Bij Christeyns zetten we data om in waardevolle inzichten. Als internationale B2B-speler in de hygiënechemie investeren we sterk in een toekomstgerichte data-omgeving die onze bedrijfsprocessen en duurzaamheidsambities ondersteunt.




Om ons data team verder te versterken, zoeken we een enthousiaste Junior Data Scientist. In deze rol krijg je de kans om je analytische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen en stap voor stap door te groeien naar een functie als Business Analyst. Je werkt mee aan projecten die een directe impact hebben op de werking en besluitvorming binnen onze internationale organisatie.




Jouw functie

Je vertaalt ruwe en complexe data uit verschillende interne en externe bronnen naar heldere, bruikbare inzichten voor proceseigenaars en management, zodat beslissingen onderbouwd en datagedreven kunnen worden genomen.
Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en onderhoudt dashboards, datamodellen en API’s die bedrijfsprocessen meetbaar, stuurbaar en transparant maken binnen een internationale organisatie.
Je werkt actief mee aan de verdere uitbouw en optimalisatie van de data-architectuur en -infrastructuur, waarbij betrouwbaarheid, performantie en schaalbaarheid centraal staan.
Je ontsluit data via gebruiksvriendelijke visualisaties en rapporteringen in tools zoals Power BI en Grafana, ondersteund door Databricks en Microsoft Azure.
Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor duurzaamheids- en ESG-gerelateerde data en zorgt voor correcte definities, consistente datasets en duidelijke rapportering ter ondersteuning van strategische doelstellingen.
Waar relevant pas je machine learning en geavanceerde analysetechnieken toe om patronen te identificeren, inzichten te verdiepen en data verder te verrijken.
Je stemt noden en verwachtingen rond data, visualisatie en voorspellende modellen af met proceseigenaars en werkt hiervoor nauw samen met IT en het data team.
Je rapporteert aan de Data Team Lead




Jouw profiel

Bachelor of Master in Data Science, Toegepaste Informatica, Handelsingenieur, Economie of een vergelijkbare richting;
Je bent een starter of hebt een eerste relevante ervaring via stage, studentenjob of een eerste werkervaring;
Interesse in data-analyse, bedrijfsprocessen en business intelligence;
Basiskennis van SQL, Power BI of Python is een pluspunt;
Interesse om door te groeien richting Business Analytics;
Zeer goede kennis van Nederlands en Engels.




Ons aanbod

Een uitdagende startersfunctie binnen een internationale en groeiende organisatie;
Begeleiding en opleiding door ervaren collega's;
Werken in een jong en dynamisch data team;
Ruimte voor initiatief, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en professionele groei;
Een marktconform salarispakket met extralegale voordelen.




Wie zijn wij?

Christeyns is een Belgische specialist in hygiëne- en reinigingsoplossingen voor onder meer wasserijen, de voedingsindustrie, schoonmaakbedrijven en de gezondheidszorg. De groep combineert de ontwikkeling en productie van reinigings- en desinfectieproducten met apparatuur, engineering, digitale toepassingen en technische dienstverlening.




Met meer dan 1.800 medewerkers en 47 dochterondernemingen wereldwijd rapporteerde Christeyns in 2025 een omzet van meer dan 487 miljoen euro. Het familiebedrijf werd opgericht in 1946 en is sinds 1989 in handen van de familie Bostoen.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - European Agency
Description:
🔹Role🔹

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist & Cloud Engineer specialised in High-Performance Computing, Cloud Architecture, scientific computing, and large-scale geospatial and oceanographic data processing, combining advanced Python software engineering with extensive experience in migrating and optimising complex computational workflows.

🔹Who We Are🔹

Altia is a high-value digital transformation services company that has undertaken, changed, and reformulated international projects for nearly a thousand clients, leaders in their sectors, who have understood that their businesses can be revolutionized through digitalization. Over its 30 years of experience, it has proven to be a robust company with a future, a capacity for innovation, and adaptability.

🔹The project🔹

You will contribute to an international scientific and technological project supporting European institutions and agencies, focused on large-scale scientific computing, geospatial data processing, and the development and optimisation of HPC and Cloud workflows.

Scientific & Geospatial Data Engineering: Develop and manage high-quality global datasets, integrating heterogeneous geospatial and oceanographic data from sources such as OpenStreetMap, satellite products, and scientific observation networks.

HPC & Scientific Computing: Design, develop, and optimise high-performance computational workflows for large-scale scientific applications and numerical modelling.

Mesh Generation & Numerical Modelling: Develop workflows for the generation of global unstructured meshes and support the calibration and optimisation of large-scale ocean modelling configurations.

Cloud & HPC Migration: Design and execute the migration and transfer of complex HPC workflows between Cloud and European HPC infrastructures, ensuring portability, scalability, and reproducibility.

Data Processing & Validation: Build robust processing and validation frameworks capable of handling very large scientific datasets and supporting the evaluation of numerical models.

Software Engineering & Automation: Develop maintainable Python-based solutions and CI/CD pipelines, using containerisation to ensure reproducible and reliable scientific computing environments.

🔹Stack🔹

Programming & Data Science: Python, scikit-learn, scientific computing and large-scale data processing.

HPC & Scientific Computing: HPC, High-Performance Computing, EuroHPC, numerical modelling and computational optimisation.

Cloud Architecture: Microsoft Azure, Cloud infrastructure and distributed computing.

Containers: Singularity, Apptainer, containerised scientific workflows and reproducible environments.

CI/CD & Automation: CI/CD pipelines, workflow automation and software delivery practices.

Scientific & Geospatial Technologies: SCHISM, GMSH, OpenStreetMap (OSM), oceanographic and geospatial datasets, satellite L3/L4 products and ARGO data.

Data Engineering & Validation: Large-scale scientific datasets, model calibration, validation frameworks and heterogeneous data integration.

Provide hands-on guidance and review the team’s work.

Track expected and realized value and ensure regulatory compliance across the organization.
